title: monitor page that automatically refreshes the sql-query
reason: A monitor page that refreshes query data is covered by the real-time monitor requirement.

title: Export split archives
reason: Large exports cannot be split into several numbered files of a chosen size.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall split large exports into numbered files at a size chosen by the user, up to a configured maximum.

title: Export Records and Relations
reason: Users want to export a row together with the rows that reference it through defined relations, recursively.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer an export of selected rows plus the rows that reference them through configured foreign keys, following references recursively with a row limit and a cycle guard.

title: Checkboxes to import data
reason: An uploaded full SQL dump can only be imported as a whole, with no way to choose tables first.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall, for an uploaded SQL dump, list the tables it creates or fills and let the user select which ones to import before any statement runs.

title: merging databases and/or tables
reason: A row-level merge of two databases with conflict choice is outside the scope of DBLoom.

title: Export tables list must be ordered by constraints
reason: The export lists tables in an order that breaks constraints on import unless foreign-key checks are disabled.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall order tables in a database SQL export so that referenced tables are created and filled first, and shall report cyclic foreign keys.

title: Auto-Updater in home window
reason: An in-app updater that downloads and overwrites code conflicts with pinned self-hosted deployment and the no-telemetry decision.

title: Comments for databases, tables, columns
reason: Database, table and column comments are not shown next to their names in navigation and lists.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show database, table and column comments next to their names in the navigation tree and the structure view.

title: [shortcuts] Please support $cfg['CtrlArrowsMoving']=false again
reason: The request is to restore a legacy switch for Ctrl-arrow word movement in cell editors, which DBLoom's new editor does not reuse.

title: Make export sql more friendly to side-by-side comparison
reason: Structure-only SQL export emits indexes and foreign keys in creation order, so two equal schemas produce different files.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall sort indexes, foreign keys and other schema objects in a fixed order in SQL exports so that equal schemas produce identical output.

title: MIME Transformation Imagelink and link - repairs and idea
reason: Legacy MIME transformation links and base-path defects belong to a plugin model DBLoom does not reuse, and file-path image links conflict with the strict CSP and upload limits.

title: Filling random test data in database
reason: Users want generated test rows that respect constraints and foreign keys.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer generation of labelled test rows for a table that respects NOT NULL, unique, check and foreign-key constraints.

title: Export progress bar
reason: Export gives no progress indication, and users want overall and per-table progress.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show export progress per table and as an overall percentage while an export runs.

title: Facilitate drag and drop of columns between tables
reason: Users want to move a column to another table by drag and drop instead of dropping and re-adding it.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let a user move a column to another table of the same database, copying its values and removing it from the source only after a confirmed step.

title: User Preferences reset should clear the value in la_userconfig
reason: A reset to default removes the user override so the file default applies, which is the behaviour the request asks for.

title: Icons of keys, FK cell value, translation.
reason: Users want key markers in column headers and a distinct style for foreign-key display text in cells.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show primary-key and foreign-key markers in column headers of the structure and browse views and display foreign-key values with their display text in a distinct style.

title: unhex() in exports
reason: Users want an SQL export option that writes every value as an UNHEX call or hexadecimal literal.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer an SQL export option that writes each value as a hexadecimal literal or UNHEX call, and shall keep the default string escaping correct.

title: Missing variables on partial import
reason: A resumed SQL import fails because restore statements assign session variables that were never set in the resumed session.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall define the session variables of an export header before running restore statements so that a resumed or partial import does not fail with NULL assignments.

title: Support high-resolution displays
reason: Icons are rendered at one resolution and blur on high-density displays.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall supply icons as vector graphics or at 2x resolution so they stay sharp on high-density displays.

title: Multi source replication is not recognized
reason: Multi-source replication status is server replication monitoring outside the scope of a table and data tool.

title: FEATURE: Handle COLUMN_JSON
reason: MariaDB dynamic columns are shown only as an opaque BLOB value.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall decode MariaDB dynamic-column values through COLUMN_JSON for display when the target is MariaDB and show the raw value on request.

title: Feature request: totally turn off autocomplete and sql syntax check
reason: Users want to switch off SQL autocomplete and live syntax checking, which add requests on slow links.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let each user turn off SQL autocomplete and live syntax checking, and shall send no background requests for them while turned off.

title: Material Design Theme
reason: A request for a Material Design theme is a theme chore, and DBLoom has its own UI design.

title: can't insert row into table that contains generated column
reason: The insert form includes generated columns in the INSERT statement, which MySQL and MariaDB reject.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall omit generated columns from INSERT and UPDATE statements and show them as read-only values.

title: Feature-Request: Pop-Out SQL Window
reason: The SQL editor cannot be opened in a separate browser window for use on another screen.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user open the SQL editor in its own browser window.

title: Adding group by functionality in table itself.
reason: Users want a grouped view of a table, started from a column header, that applies GROUP BY with the usual aggregate functions.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a grouped view started from a column header that applies GROUP BY to that column and offers the common aggregate functions for the other columns.

title: Allow setting session variables (eg: sql_mode)
reason: Users cannot set session variables such as sql_mode for their own connection without a global change.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let a user set allow-listed session variables such as sql_mode for their own connection without requiring global privileges.

title: Default DB
reason: Users want a configured default database opened automatically after login.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let an administrator or user set a default database that is opened after login.

title: Avoid removing invalid value for relations
reason: A foreign-key picker with no matching target row resets the stored value to the default when the form is saved.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep an existing stored value when no matching row exists in the referenced table and shall show that value as unresolved instead of replacing it.

title: Back not working correctly on export
reason: Browser Back after an export download lands on a blank query page.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the previous page rendered when the user navigates back from an export or download page.

title: Doesn't detect duplicate index
reason: The duplicate-index check compares uniqueness, so a UNIQUE key and a plain key on the same column are never reported as redundant.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report a non-unique index as redundant when a unique index on the same leading columns exists in the same table.

title: Filtering: Exporting tables
reason: The database export page offers no name or regex filter for its table list, unlike the navigation tree.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide a name filter, with an optional regular expression, above the table selection on the database export page.

title: Unable to browse results when SQL contains a user defined variable
reason: Paging controls are shown for a multi-statement query whose result cannot be paged, so Next returns nothing.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer Next and Previous controls only for a result set it has paged itself and shall show a notice when a multi-statement query has no pageable result.

title: Action column position
reason: The row action column sits in a different position on the database, table, browse and structure lists.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall place the row action column in the same position on every list of objects and rows.

title: Replication setup broken with SSL
reason: Replication administration is outside the scope of a table and data tool, and the legacy status page is covered only by FR-SRV-004.

title: Improve notification after drag and drop import
reason: After a dropped SQL file is uploaded nothing tells the user what to do next.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall, when a dropped file finishes uploading, show its detected format and offer explicit Review and Import actions.

title: Remove inline styles
reason: Inline styles are excluded by the strict CSP and styling is meant to live in the theme stylesheets.

title: Proposal: add option to set warning if more than X rows are affected by a statement
reason: No row-count threshold exists, so a mass UPDATE or DELETE gets only a generic confirmation.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall ask for a second confirmation showing the affected row count when an UPDATE or DELETE would exceed a configurable threshold set per statement type.

title: Visual enum editor adds extra (blank) values
reason: The visual enum editor writes blank entries as real enum members, for example enum('a','b','','').
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall drop blank entries from the enum and set editor before building the column definition, unless the user adds an empty member on purpose.

title: Designer should remember expanded/collapsed state
reason: The designer does not store the expanded or collapsed state of table boxes in a saved layout.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall store the expanded or collapsed state of each table box as part of a saved designer layout.

title: Adding a common prefix for column names
reason: Users want a column-name prefix applied automatically when creating a table or adding columns.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user set a column-name prefix that is applied to new columns in the create-table and add-column forms.

title: Better error reporting when creating routines
reason: A routine save error is shown in a popup that repeats the whole routine body, which is too large to read.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show routine error messages in a scrollable area and shall not repeat the submitted routine body in the message.

title: structure window improvement
reason: The structure page opens the partitions section and collapses the indexes section by default.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the indexes section expanded by default on the table structure page.

title: Request method to specify columns displayed in selected Designer tables
reason: The relationship designer always draws every column of each table, which makes large diagrams hard to lay out.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user limit the displayed columns of each table box in the designer, or collapse the box to its title, and store that choice with the saved layout.

title: Setup script: suggest using SSL when available
reason: The legacy setup only shows a generic SSL hint and does not test whether the server supports TLS.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall test TLS support when a target is added, show the result, and offer the steps to enable TLS when the server does not support it.

title: Allow SSL connection when using arbitrary server
reason: Target TLS defaults to required with verification on, which covers the arbitrary-server SSL concern.

title: Warn user when using an outdated or vulnerable MySQL version
reason: The legacy specification has no warning when the connected MySQL or MariaDB release is end-of-life or known to be vulnerable.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show a persistent warning for any connected target whose MySQL or MariaDB release is end-of-life or below the supported minimum, naming the minimum.

title: Use dynamic strict CSP policy
reason: The strict nonce-based CSP without unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval replaces the legacy dynamic policy.

title: CSP blocks TextImageLinkTransformationsPlugin
reason: External image URLs are blocked by the strict nonce-based CSP by design, and the image-link plugin is only a legacy inventory item.

title: AllowThirdPartyFraming improvement with CSP policy
reason: Framing is governed by one frame-protection policy, and the legacy plan to widen it is deferred to ENV-only with none allowed in the first release.

title: Reduce metadata exposure in PDF report
reason: PDF exports embed the tool name, version and timestamps in the document metadata with no option to remove them.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall write only the document title and creation date into exported PDF metadata and omit software name and version fields.

title: DROP database and user privileges
reason: Dropping a database or table leaves its grants in place and DBLoom offers no way to review or revoke them.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall, after dropping a database or table, list the grants that still name it and offer to revoke them only after explicit confirmation.

title: Replace TCPDF with tc-lib-pdf or mpdf
reason: Swapping the PHP PDF library does not apply, since DBLoom is TypeScript.

title: Improve testsuite for cookie authentication
reason: Tests of the legacy cookie authentication flows do not apply to DBLoom.

title: Rewrite GIS editor to not rely on eval()
reason: The GIS editor must not use eval, and a strict CSP without eval is already required; the WKT editor is specified in FR-IOX-067.

title: Import progress bar
reason: Import progress is specified only for the upload (FR-IOX-060, FR-IOX-061); progress while statements execute is not.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show import progress while statements run, as the number of statements or bytes processed and the table of the current statement, updated during the import.

title: Dumps containing "SET NAMES utf8mb4" sometimes cause collation errors on joins if tables are defined with "COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci"
reason: Dumps start with SET NAMES utf8mb4 while some tables use older collations, causing collation errors on joins after import.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall write export headers whose character set and collations match each exported object, so that an exported dump imports without collation errors.

title: Documentation for WAF configuration
reason: ModSecurity rule documentation for the legacy PHP application does not apply.

title: Provide AppArmor profile
reason: An AppArmor profile for mod_apparmor on the legacy PHP web server does not apply.

title: CSP improvements
reason: A strict CSP with no unneeded sources is already required.

title: Use Prepared Statements instead of Dynamic SQL Queries when possible
reason: The spec records prepared statements only as an observation (02-server.md, security posture) and has no requirement to bind data values.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall send every data value as a bound parameter of a prepared statement and shall quote identifiers through an allow-list.

title: Use Strict SQL_MODE by default
reason: The spec does not set an explicit strict session sql_mode on connections DBLoom opens.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall set an explicit strict sql_mode on every connection it opens and shall show the active mode in the connection details.

title: Warn on usage of HTTP links in SETUP
reason: It concerns legacy SignonURL, LogoutURL and NavigationLogoLink settings, which DBLoom does not have.

title: Add option to generate stripped version of config file in SETUP
reason: A setup-script option to write a stripped config file does not apply, since DBLoom configuration comes from environment variables.

title: Improve the update message
reason: The update notice gives no release-notes link and no release type, so users cannot judge its urgency.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show, in any update notice, a link to the release notes and the kind of release (security, fix or feature).

title: Per request cache for analyzed queries
reason: Per-request caching of parsed SQL is an internal optimisation of the legacy PHP code.

title: [shortcuts] WRT Ctrl navigation in grid editor #6068
reason: Shortcut handling captures Ctrl+Shift arrow keys inside the grid editor, which breaks word selection; the spec notes that shortcuts ignore modifier keys but has no requirement for this.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not intercept standard text-editing key combinations (Ctrl, Alt or Meta with arrows, letters or Home/End) inside editable fields.

title: Puppet support
reason: Puppet modules for the legacy PHP application do not apply.

title: no way to return from the export page
reason: After an export there is no link back to the page the export started from.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a link from the export page back to the page the export was started from.

title: File Permissions Issues related to legacyadmin Release process
reason: File permissions in the legacy PHP release tarballs do not apply to DBLoom.

title: Verify Twitter account
reason: Verifying the project's Twitter account is a marketing item.

title: Foreign key editor can not add correct default name for new foreign key if another one already exists
reason: The default name suggested for a new foreign key can repeat an existing constraint name on the same table.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall generate a default foreign-key name that is unique among the constraint names of the table.

title: Foreign keys user-experience enhancement
reason: Index rows in the structure view should show foreign-key markers, and the user should be able to choose whether indexes are expanded by default.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall mark index rows that belong to an internal or external foreign key with a distinct, labelled indicator, and shall let the user choose whether index lists are expanded by default.

title: Session locking
reason: The legacy session lock is released only for manual queries (FR-DTB-024), so long statements issued by the application still block the user's other pages.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not hold a session-store lock while any target statement runs, including statements DBLoom issues itself.

title: Sugestion - Run SQL in all (or selected) databases
reason: Running one SQL script against several or all selected databases, with results per database, is requested and not in the spec.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user run one SQL script against several selected databases and show the result for each database separately.

title: Back-link on database-privileges edit page
reason: Edit pages have no link back to their parent list and browser back does not work reliably.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall give each edit page a visible link back to its parent list and shall keep browser back and forward working on all pages.

title: Errors/Warnings from HTML checker
reason: HTML validator warnings concern obsolete markup in the legacy PHP templates, which DBLoom does not reuse.

title: Run the mouse selected query
reason: Running only the selected text of the SQL editor is a standard database-tool feature that the spec does not mention.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall execute only the selected text of the SQL editor when a selection exists.

title: Refactor/Remove inline <script> usages
reason: A strict CSP with no inline script, using nonces, is already required.

title: Multi-level database trees not collapsed when root prefix is the only prefix present
reason: Navigation tree grouping by prefix already covers the single-root-prefix case.

title: Text to display for foreign keys
reason: Foreign-key display supports one column and either key or display text; showing several display columns and key plus text together is not specified.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let a foreign-key reference use several display columns and shall offer a display format that shows both the key and the display text.

title: MySQL data function shortcut on insert rows no longer works
reason: Applying a generated-value function chosen for one row to all empty rows in one action is missing from the insert form.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user apply a chosen generated-value function to all empty rows of the insert form with one action.

title: Setup improvements
reason: Setup features are covered by the ENV/UI settings split, the version check off by default, and the ban on uploaded CSS and templates.

title: Export using user defined variables results in NULL
reason: Exporting a result set that depends on session variables set by an earlier statement yields NULL, because only the final SELECT is re-run.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export the result of the exact statement sequence the user ran, including session variables set by earlier statements in that sequence.

title: Configuration storage - fallback to default table names when pmadb config is set
reason: It concerns fallback table names of the legacy la_ configuration storage, which DBLoom does not use.

title: Change table types for a group of tables
reason: Bulk change of the storage engine for selected tables is a useful operation that the spec does not cover.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user change the storage engine of several selected tables in one operation, report the result for each table and warn about locking before it starts.

title: Feature request for slow systems in memory or bandwidth
reason: Users want the generated SQL shown and copyable for failed or timed-out operations, which the spec does not require.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the generated SQL of any failed or timed-out operation with a copy action.

title: Tables not shown if !NavigationTreeEnableExpansion and !ShowDatabasesNavigationAsTree
reason: Whether tables disappear when procedures exist and both navigation options are off must be checked in the legacy navigation code.

title: Save and Preview SQL buttons for Relations
reason: The reporter does not know what the Save and Preview SQL buttons should do or whether they work; the spec's preview-SQL requirements are for foreign keys only.

title: Adding key to text field doesn't prompt for required key size
reason: An index on a BLOB or TEXT column is accepted without asking for the required prefix length.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall require a prefix length for each BLOB or TEXT index column before the index form can be submitted.

title: Export Database structure with MSSQL compatibility fails to create table structure
reason: The SQL export in MSSQL compatibility mode with backquoted identifiers writes CREATE TABLE statements that fail on import.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall quote identifiers in each export compatibility mode with the quoting the target dialect accepts, and shall refuse a combination it cannot produce correctly.

title: Export/Import pMA DB data
reason: Exporting the legacy LegacyAdmin configuration-storage tables for version control does not apply, since DBLoom uses its own store.

title: Consistent UI for selecting structure / data export
reason: The body describes a layout inconsistency only through a screenshot and gives no concrete behaviour.

title: db_export insert syntax options
reason: The SQL export already offers extended INSERT syntax and maximum query size; the separate column-name option is not stated but is minor.

title: Read Only fields
reason: Actions the connected account cannot use are shown as read-only instead of being hidden or disabled with a reason; the spec covers only the privilege check.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall hide or disable each action that the connected account's privileges do not allow, and shall show the missing privilege as the reason.

title: Cannot user insert feature with database specific right
reason: Read-only fields came from a global-SELECT check instead of the privilege actually required, which SEC-TGT-062 already forbids.

title: Hiding Tables in Server Overview doesn't reduce the Pages
reason: The table-list page count still includes hidden tables, so empty pages are shown.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall compute the table-list pagination from visible tables only, so no empty page appears after tables are hidden.

title: Report also count query timings
reason: Users compare displayed query times with server-side times; the spec measures statement time (FR-DTB-012) but does not separate server time, round-trip time and the count query.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report the server-side execution time and the round-trip time of each data query, and the duration of its row count query separately.

title: Disability tools
reason: Users with visual impairments ask for keyboard, screen-reader and contrast support; the spec only lists accessibility as an open question.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall meet WCAG 2.2 level AA for keyboard operation, screen-reader labels and text contrast in both light and dark themes.

title: Unable to rename column when it's part of a partition
reason: Renaming a column used in a partition expression fails with an unexplained server error and the spec has no partition-aware rename handling.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall detect that a column is used in a partitioning expression before a rename and either update the partition definition in the same operation or refuse the rename with an explanation.

title: Choose your layout at main menu
reason: Users want to choose which main-menu items and labels are shown, which the spec does not describe (FR-UIX-042 covers only hidden navigation tree items).
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let each user choose which top-level menu items are shown, with a default that shows all items.

title: Cannot add foreign key constraint (in import) even when using "Disable foreign keys" option
reason: The spec already requires FK checks to be disabled during import (FR-IOX-057) and suspended for destructive operations (FR-DTB-049).

title: Visual Editor for creating Relations and Views
reason: Users want to create foreign-key relations and views visually in the designer canvas.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let users create and delete foreign-key relations from the designer canvas.

title: Calculated column value is not being updated after an inline edit
reason: Generated (virtual) column values shown after an inline edit stay stale until the page is fully reloaded.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall refresh the values of generated columns in the edited row after an inline save.

title: Dropdown when editing enum default value
reason: The enum default value is a free-text field, and a dropdown of the enum members would prevent invalid defaults.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a dropdown of the enum members when the user edits the default value of an enum column.

title: Don't validate SQL in a way that blocks input
reason: The legacy remote SQL validator that blocked typing does not exist in 5.2.3, so the issue cannot recur.

title: Have to log in twice after session timeout
reason: Login required twice after a session timeout is covered by the session-expiry modal and inactivity requirements.

title: SignonScript do not perform successful login in
reason: Signon login that does not complete through SignonScript is covered by the SignonScript execution requirement.

title: Import ends up with timeout, produces a partial import
reason: Large imports that time out and leave a partial import are covered by the import timeout and resumption requirements.

title: Document accesibility status (VPAT)
reason: Public-sector users ask for an accessibility conformance statement (VPAT or equivalent).
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall publish an accessibility conformance statement for its user interface.

title: Edit an exiting row and setting auto increment should prompt to add index
reason: Setting AUTO_INCREMENT on a non-key column in the edit dialog fails with error 1075 instead of offering to add a key.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer to add a key when the user sets AUTO_INCREMENT on a column that has no index, instead of submitting an invalid definition.

title: Remove inline javascript events
reason: Removing inline JavaScript event handlers is required by the strict Content-Security-Policy and nonce rules.

title: use strict mode for legacyadmin JS files
reason: Strict-mode request for legacy JavaScript files; DBLoom is written in TypeScript.

title: Use JS requests as fallback for PHP server side requests
reason: Concerns the PHP server-side HTTP requests of the legacy tool; DBLoom does not reuse that code path.

title: wrong field length on csv import that creates table
reason: Wrong column lengths when a CSV import creates a table; the upstream change makes CSV columns that overflow become TEXT.

title: Can't add extra columns when adding columns
reason: After adding one column, the structure page cannot add several columns in one step.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user add several columns in one operation on the table structure page.

title: Option to keep query editable directly
reason: Users want the executed query to stay editable in the SQL tab without an extra Edit Inline step.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the query text of the SQL tab editable directly after the query has run.

title: The process to create a table in a database is non-intuitive
reason: The import result reports a count of successful statements that does not match the failed DROP TABLE statement, which misleads the user about what ran.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report the number of executed and failed statements accurately and show the server error of each failed statement.

title: Query cache advisor
reason: Query cache advisor; the MySQL query cache was removed in 8.0, below DBLoom's minimum of 8.4.

title: problem in creating new table
reason: The report of problems creating new tables gives no steps, error text or version in the title or body.

title: hide-db globaly for AllowArbitraryServer
reason: Hidden-database rules apply only per server, so setups with AllowArbitraryServer cannot hide system databases globally.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let hidden-database rules apply across all servers, including arbitrary-server connections.

title: Cannot inline edit when a join is used in 4.7.2, works fine in 4.2.5
reason: Inline edit and row actions disappear for result sets produced by a JOIN even though the base table keys are known.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show row edit and delete actions for join results whenever the key columns of each base table are in the result, and shall explain when it cannot.

title: While Importing Database, Drag-n-drop is not working
reason: Drag-and-drop SQL import that does nothing is covered by the drag-and-drop import requirements.

title: Clarify charset / collation change warning
reason: Question about the wording of a legacy charset and collation warning; not a behaviour requirement.

title: Designer should show tables from other databases by default
reason: The designer hides tables from other databases unless a saved layout includes them and does not mark them visually.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show tables that are related to tables in the current database by default and mark them as belonging to another database.

title: Add support for CHECK constraints (feature request)
reason: Request for CHECK constraint management in create and structure views and in export is already covered by the proposed FR-TGT-220 in 13-new-features (not yet approved).

title: Blocks in the new multi-table query UI should be movable
reason: Blocks in the multi-table query builder cannot be reordered, although their left-to-right order defines the generated query.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let users reorder the table blocks of the multi-table query builder and shall generate the query in that order.

title: Bookmarked search disappeared from the new multi-table query UI
reason: Saved searches were removed from the multi-table query builder and users want to save and recall query definitions.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let users save and reload multi-table query definitions.

title: Monitor graphs are not translated after changing language
reason: Translation of legacy monitor charts is a localisation chore, and the language scope for DBLoom is not defined.

title: Export View is creating table as well
reason: Exporting a view also emits CREATE TABLE and DROP TABLE statements for a stand-in table, which are wrong for a view and break re-import.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export a view only as a view definition, without table stand-in statements.

title: Lower than expected query time
reason: The displayed query time covers only the row-fetch query and not the separate count query, so it understates the total time.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report a query time that includes every statement run to produce the displayed result.

title: Exporting query results with DISTINCT clause produce SQL with string values not surrounded by quotes
reason: Query-result SQL export with DISTINCT leaves char and varchar values unquoted, producing a file that cannot be imported.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall quote and escape all string values in every SQL export, including exports of query results.

title: Sort edit field dropdowns
reason: Sorting of legacy transformation and MIME dropdown lists is cosmetic and tied to the legacy plugin set.

title: [shortcuts] Emacs keybindings
reason: Emacs keybindings for the SQL editor are a niche preference and not a requirement for a MySQL admin tool.

title: Drop table confirmation
reason: The drop confirmation buries the table name in the dialog body instead of showing it in the title.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the name of the affected object in the title of every destructive-operation confirmation dialog.

title: Order distinct values table by count
reason: The distinct-values list is ordered by value, while ordering by count descending would be more useful.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer ordering the distinct-values list by count, descending.

title: Copy database to operation creates views referring to the original database
reason: Copy database keeps view definitions that reference the source database name, so the copied views read from the original database.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall rewrite database qualifiers in copied view definitions to the target database name and report any view it could not retarget.

title: Warning the user before executing a query not using index
reason: Users want a warning before running a query that EXPLAIN shows as not using an index on a large table.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall warn before executing a query that EXPLAIN reports as not using an index on a table above a configurable row estimate.

title: [shortcuts] disable keybinding for ctrl-f
reason: Ctrl-F is captured by the page's keyboard shortcut handling; the spec already records this modifier issue as an open decision.

title: Improve error message when Recent table/database doesn't exist
reason: Opening a Recent item whose database or table was removed shows a generic "No database selected" message instead of naming the missing item.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall name the missing database or table when a recent item no longer exists and shall remove that item from the recent list.

title: Generating PHP insert code
reason: Request for generated PHP PDO code; PHP-specific and outside a MySQL admin tool.

title: Better integrate storing user preferences in browser local storage
reason: User preferences do not persist across sessions when no server-side configuration storage is set up; browser local storage could hold them instead.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep user preferences across sessions when the server-side preference store is unavailable by falling back to browser local storage.

title: Foreign key constraints with IF NOT EXISTS
reason: SQL export with IF NOT EXISTS still emits ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT statements, so re-importing into an existing schema fails with duplicate constraint errors.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall make an export with IF NOT EXISTS re-importable into an existing schema by omitting or guarding constraint statements that already exist.

title: No copy/paste UI to click in query editor
reason: The SQL query editor and inline editor offer no right-click cut, copy and paste menu, although keyboard shortcuts work.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide the standard cut, copy and paste actions in the context menu of the SQL editor.

title: Confusion around settings RowActionType/ActionLinksMode
reason: The RowActionType setting is documented but has no effect on the row action icons, so a documented option silently does nothing.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply every display option it documents for row actions and shall not document options that have no effect.

title: Cannot make seperate connection on NamedPipe(Windows)
reason: Login hangs until the PHP execution time limit when a socket or named-pipe connection is misconfigured on Windows, instead of failing fast with an error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall fail a MySQL connection attempt within a configurable timeout and show the underlying connect error instead of hanging.

title: sql code truncated in Edit inline mode
reason: Defect of the legacy inline SQL editor (CodeMirror height in LegacyAdmin 4.7.7); DBLoom uses its own editor.

title: Feature: merge column if re-import modified sql file
reason: The request to merge a column when a changed SQL file is re-imported is not clear enough to judge from the title and body.

title: Table Search Slow w/ Foreign Keys
reason: Table search runs count(*) on referenced tables to choose between a dropdown and a popup, so large, frequently changing referenced tables make pages very slow.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not run row-count queries on referenced tables to choose a foreign-key picker unless the user enables it, and shall use a bounded probe instead.

title: Adaptive Fonts
reason: Users on large high-resolution monitors ask for adaptive or scalable font sizes.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user scale the interface font size in user preferences without reloading the page.

title: Deleting a pma database user deletes all legacyadmin data
reason: Deleting a MySQL user in the legacy tool silently wiped the application's own stored data (bookmarks, history) without any warning.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall warn before deleting a MySQL account that owns DBLoom-stored data and shall keep that data unless the user explicitly chooses to remove it.

title: Actions are in More menu while there's plenty of space.
reason: Row action links are hidden in the More menu even when the table has horizontal room to show them.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show row actions as inline controls when the row has enough horizontal space and move them into a menu only when it does not.

title: [shortcuts] add a shortcut to jump to table using keyboard
reason: No keyboard shortcut to jump to a table by name
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide a keyboard shortcut that opens a table-name search within the current database.

title: Too many fields(>13 in my case) in a table leading to page overflow
reason: Wide tables overflow the page and force horizontal scrolling of the whole page
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep wide tables scrollable inside their own container so that the page does not scroll horizontally.

title: change the text to Log in instead of Go on login page
reason: Label wording change on the login page

title: Migrate feature of ODS import to CSV import: First column contains column names
reason: The CSV import has no option to take column names from the first row
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a CSV import option that takes column names from the first row.

title: Authentication failures not showing in log files when using php cgi
reason: Authentication failures are not logged under PHP CGI; DBLoom is not PHP

title: Add support for encrypted .zip files for import and export
reason: Password-protected ZIP archives cannot be imported or exported
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall accept password-protected ZIP archives for import, ask the user for the password, and never store it.

title: Quick filter for result table
reason: Quick filter for result rows

title: Import from uploaded file is very slow and gets time-out on LEMP (tested with with version 4.7.6, 4.7.9)
reason: Import from an uploaded file times out; timeout resumption is specified

title: 2 Factor text is slightly wrong. (HOTP)
reason: Explanatory text mentions HOTP, but DBLoom offers TOTP and passkeys only

title: Allow Multiple U2F Devices
reason: Only one hardware security key can be registered for an account
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall allow each user to register more than one passkey or security key.

title: 2FA Request Page Enhancements
reason: The second-factor challenge page has no log-out or retry action after an error
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a log-out action and a retry on every second-factor challenge page.

title: Remove Backspace functionality
reason: Backspace navigates back to the previous page and can discard unsaved input
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not navigate away on Backspace outside an editable field.

title: Dublicated notes in foreign-key field
reason: Foreign-key selector shows duplicate entries when the referenced values are not unique; the body does not fully describe the case

title: Bar graph has fixed height
reason: Bar chart canvas has a fixed height, so long result sets are clipped
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall size chart canvases to the number of plotted rows so that no bar is clipped.

title: MySQL 8.0.11 spatial data type changes
reason: GEOMCOLLECTION naming change in MySQL 8.0.11; DBLoom uses current server names

title: MySQL 8.0.11 SQL compatibility mode changes
reason: Removed deprecated SQL compatibility modes; DBLoom targets MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 10.11 only

title: changing servers resets LegacyAdmin cookie
reason: Switching between servers logs the user out of the others because of cookie handling

title: Themes - general CSS guidelines
reason: CSS style guideline for the LegacyAdmin theme code

title: browse table links fail when user has column specific privileges
reason: Browse links use SELECT * and fail for users who have only column-level SELECT
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall browse a table for a user with column-level SELECT only by selecting the granted columns.

title: Importing a SQL TRIGGER statement with backslash as content, and then exporting again results in a different SQL statement (a wrong one)
reason: Backslashes in trigger bodies are altered by an import and export round trip
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export routine, event and trigger bodies byte-for-byte as stored by the server.

title: Force two-factor auth
reason: An administrator cannot require second-factor enrolment for all users
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let an administrator require second-factor enrolment for all users or for selected roles.

title: Add high-level column types and integrate data to external websites
reason: Users want presentation column types such as colour or Wikidata ID that sit on a base MySQL type
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall allow a column to carry a presentation type, such as colour, that maps onto a base MySQL type without changing the stored data.

title: Support expressions (functions) for field defaults (table definition), ALTER, INSERT, CREATE?
reason: Expression defaults such as unix_timestamp() are quoted and stored as string literals
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall pass a column DEFAULT expression to the server as SQL and never as a quoted string.

title: Support using hexadecimal constants in input fields for numeric values
reason: Hexadecimal literals such as 0x101 are rejected in numeric inputs and default values
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall accept hexadecimal and bit literals in numeric inputs and pass them to MySQL unchanged.

title: Too much time for a database import
reason: Importing a 90 MB dump through the web app takes about six times longer than the mysql client over the same network
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall import a dump over the network within a stated factor of the time the mysql command-line client needs for the same file.

title: Default for $cfg['TempDir']
reason: Default value of the PHP TempDir setting

title: Charset definition doesn't take effect on new databases
reason: Configured default charset and collation are not applied to new databases

title: Suggestion: Setting option to hide the SQL Terminal.
reason: Option to hide the SQL console from the settings

title: Suggestion: Adding a link to create entry into related table2 when inserting element in table1
reason: No shortcut from an insert form to create the missing row in the referenced table
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user open the referenced table's insert form from a foreign-key selector and return with the new key selected.

title: Feature: Save width of columns
reason: User-set column widths in the result grid reset when the table page is reopened
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall remember user-set column widths per table between visits.

title: 2FA: Recovery key?
reason: Recovery when the user loses the second-factor device

title: Composer create-project complains about outdated lock file
reason: Composer create-project lock-file warning

title: Can't add index in edit field form.
reason: The column edit form has no index selector, although the add-column form has one, so AUTO_INCREMENT cannot be set first
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user add an index to a column in the column edit form as well as in the add-column form.

title: restore support for forceSSL setting
reason: Request to restore the PHP ForceSSL setting; the SPEC already delegates HTTPS enforcement to the web server (05-security-auth.md, near line 782)

title: Changing collations may need to drop and recreate stored procedures
reason: Changing a database collation leaves stored routines using the old defaults until they are recreated
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall warn when a database character set or collation change affects stored routines that rely on database defaults.

title: Feature request: improve error message for The $cfg['TempDir'] (./tmp/) is not accessible.
reason: TempDir error message for the PHP Twig template cache

title: pre-compile templates before release
reason: Precompiling PHP Twig templates before release

title: LegacyAdmin Exit button popup text shows 'Empty Session Data'
reason: Legacy tooltip text on the configuration exit button in the LegacyAdmin UI

title: I can't create (edit) privilege of table and column level
reason: The table- and column-level privilege editor raises undefined-index notices and cannot save on MariaDB with versioning privileges
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render the table and column privilege editors without errors on MariaDB 10.11 and MySQL 8.4, including versioning-related privileges.

title: column without index, Foreign Key auto to be default indexed, missing one FK
reason: Creating a foreign key on an unindexed column silently adds an index, and one of two foreign keys is missing afterwards
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall create every foreign key the user defines and shall show any index that MySQL adds implicitly for it.

title: Create user form should support auth_socket by disabling password input
reason: The create-user form requires a password even for authentication plugins such as auth_socket that take none
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall make the password field optional or hidden when creating a user with an authentication plugin that takes no password.

title: AuthLog: sucessful logins repeated in log file, logouts not correctly logged
reason: The authentication log repeats successful-login lines and does not log logouts correctly
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall write exactly one authentication log entry per login and one per logout.

title: Improve Preview window
reason: The SQL preview window forces the whole query onto one line instead of wrapping it
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall wrap long SQL in preview windows rather than forcing a single line.

title: Empy string default
reason: An empty string is displayed as a blank cell, indistinguishable from an empty cell or an unset value
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall display an empty string in the data grid with a visible marker that is distinct from NULL and from an empty cell.

title: Support PDF format in Input/OutputTransformation
reason: Users want an inline preview for PDF values in binary columns, as already exists for images
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer an inline preview for PDF files stored in binary columns, comparable to the image preview.

title: Improve CONTRIBUTING.md file
reason: Contributing guide improvement for the LegacyAdmin project

title: Tooltip for truncated strings
reason: The truncated-string tooltip shows only the original length, not how much of the value is displayed
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show, for every truncated value, the original length and the number of characters displayed.

title: web access for user using unix-socket authentication over ssh tunnel
reason: Support question about unix_socket login through an SSH tunnel to a PHP web app

title: Binary relation link
reason: Binary key values break foreign-key navigation links because the value does not survive the link round trip
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall navigate from a binary foreign-key value to the referenced row using an encoding that round-trips the exact bytes.

title: Extract HTML in PHP files to Twig templates
reason: PHP Twig template extraction; DBLoom has no PHP templates

title: Discrepancy in reset button while inserting in table
reason: Font weight of the reset button differs between pages, a CSS consistency chore of the legacy theme.

title: Suggest showing connection time zone when displaying / inserting timestamp columns
reason: Browse and insert forms do not show the session time zone next to TIMESTAMP values.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the session time zone next to every TIMESTAMP value in browse and insert forms.

title: Import SQL very slow in 4.8.4
reason: The report says SQL import became far slower after 4.8.4 and times out, with no reproduction or diagnosis of the cause.

title: Saved Logins for Server Switching.
reason: Logging into a second server logs out the first, so switching servers needs repeated logins.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let a user keep several target-server connections open in one session and switch between them without logging in again.

title: Not possible to use an iprange or cidr in TrustedProxies
reason: TrustedProxies entries are matched as literal addresses, so CIDR ranges of trusted proxies are never honoured.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall match trusted proxy entries as IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR ranges and shall ignore forwarded client-address headers from any peer outside those ranges.

title: DB import should ask confirmation
reason: A SQL import runs immediately without confirmation, although it can drop or overwrite data.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall ask for explicit confirmation before running an import that contains DROP, TRUNCATE or DELETE statements or targets a database that already has tables.

title: Ability to favorite databases similar to tables
reason: Only tables can be marked as favourites, so users of servers with hundreds of databases have no shortcut to frequent ones.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let a user mark databases as favourites and list them first in the navigation tree.

title: Allow displaying exact string contents (VARCHAR as binary or hexadecimal)
reason: Browse cannot show a value as bytes or hexadecimal, so line-break type and exact content cannot be checked.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user view any text or binary cell as hexadecimal and show line-break characters explicitly.

title: Implement Page/Column Compression options
reason: The table and column editors offer no MariaDB page compression or column compression options.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer PAGE_COMPRESSED and column COMPRESSED options in the table and column editors when the connected MariaDB server supports them.

title: LegacyAdmin is not fully compatible with a custom argument separator
reason: The PHP arg_separator setting breaks query parameters in the legacy web app; DBLoom has no such setting.

title: Text size controller button in legacyadmin, SQL.
reason: Text in the SQL editor and grids is too small, so users zoom the whole page.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a per-user font-size preference for the SQL editor and result grids.

title: Extract mysql variable/config recommendations/check into a separate package
reason: Extracting the MySQL advisor into a separate package for another CMS is outside DBLoom's scope.

title: [shortcuts] "Goto Anything" navigation like Sublime Text
reason: No quick-open command exists to jump to a database or table by typing part of its name.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide a keyboard quick-open that jumps to any database, table or view by typing part of its name.

title: Bootstrap button class missing
reason: Bootstrap button classes in a legacy settings modal are a theme chore.

title: Allow disable SSL globally, not per server
reason: TLS for target connections is governed by the deployment TLS mode and TLS-by-default rules, not a per-server flag.

title: Alignment of any modal is not flexible
reason: Modal dialogs opened from dynamically added controls are misplaced when the window is resized.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep every modal dialog centred and fully visible at every supported viewport width and after window resize.

title: select @var issue
reason: Exporting a query that reads user variables set by earlier statements yields NULLs, because the export runs the SELECT without that session state.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall run an export query in the session that set its user variables, or shall reject the export with an explanation when a variable it reads is unset.

title: Refactoring designer
reason: Designer JavaScript refactoring of the legacy front end.

title: Improving performance of javascript
reason: JavaScript style refactoring of the legacy front end.

title: Column support for currency kind of values
reason: A currency display for integer columns is speculative, since MySQL has no currency type and the request is not concrete.

title: LegacyAdmin hangs on LOCK TABLES statement with MySQL 5.7
reason: A SQL script with LOCK TABLES hangs the page and keeps the server busy, and the hang recurs after reopening.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall run SQL scripts on a connection that releases table locks on completion, error or cancellation, and shall let the user cancel a running statement.

title: text not wrapping according to column size
reason: Long text in result cells does not wrap to the column width, so widening the column has no effect.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall wrap long text in result cells to the current column width and re-wrap it when the column is resized.

title: Positioning Panel
reason: The logout and home links sit at the top left, while many users expect logout at the top right.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user choose whether the account and logout controls sit at the top left or the top right of the header, defaulting to the top right.

title: copy row/edit and insert as new does not consider different UPDATE/INSERT privileges
reason: The copy and insert-as-new forms require the UPDATE privilege for columns, so a user with only INSERT cannot fill in those columns.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall decide whether a column is editable in an insert-as-new or copy form by the INSERT privilege on that column, not by UPDATE.

title: `Warning: #1287 'SHOW PROFILE' is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Please use Performance Schema instead`
reason: Query profiling uses SHOW PROFILE, which is deprecated and prints a warning on each use.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall measure statement profiles from performance_schema and shall not issue SHOW PROFILE statements.

title: Server Status Advisor: Increase or Decrease key_buffer_size?
reason: The advisor can show contradictory recommendations for one variable, such as increasing and decreasing key_buffer_size, without any conflict notice.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show a conflict note, instead of two contradictory recommendations, when two advisor rules give opposite advice for the same variable.

title: tmp dir not created on install
reason: Composer install and the missing PHP temp directory do not apply to DBLoom.

title: Allow for tables and views in same branch in navigation tree view
reason: Tables and views are listed in separate branches under each database, so reaching a view takes extra clicks.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall list tables and views together under each database node in the navigation tree, with a visual marker that distinguishes views.

title: [Discussion] Remove defined('TESTSUITE') from codebase
reason: Removing PHP test-suite hooks is an internal refactoring of the legacy code base.

title: LegacyAdmin doesn't check the real value of max_input_vars
reason: max_input_vars is a PHP ini limit that does not apply to a TypeScript application.

title: Disable SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS
reason: Expensive SELECTs always run a total-row count, and no per-query option exists to skip it.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a per-query option to browse without calculating the total row count, showing the total as unknown and limiting paging accordingly.

title: pagination allowed behind last row in view
reason: Next-page navigation is offered beyond the last row of a view, which shows an empty page.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall disable next-page navigation past the last row for views as well as for tables, and shall clamp an out-of-range position to the last page.

title: LegacyAdmin silently ignores MySQL errors on export
reason: An export that hits a query error silently stops and delivers a truncated file as if it were complete.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall abort an export when a data query fails, show the error to the user, and not present a partial file as a completed export.

title: Case sensitive: does not contain a unique column
reason: Key-column detection for editing is case-sensitive, so ID and id are treated as different columns although MySQL column names are case-insensitive.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall compare column names case-insensitively when deciding whether a result column matches a key column of the table.

title: Proposal to reduce the load on the web server with DataURI
reason: Inlining small images as data URIs to save HTTP requests is an asset-loading tweak of the PHP application.

title: BIGINT UNSIGNED value is out of range
reason: The automated error report has no user description, so the originating feature cannot be identified from the text.

title: User requires mysql.proc SELECT access to execute routines
reason: A user with routine execute rights but without the routines privilege is told that the routine was not found, hiding the real cause.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report a missing routine privilege as a missing privilege, naming the required privilege, when a routine is listed but cannot be read or executed.

title: Timeout Loading Large Database Structure
reason: Paged table navigation with lazy child loading addresses the large-database hang described in the report.

title: ZIP Export with discrete table files have indexes elsewhere!
reason: The separate-files archive export writes table structure files without indexes or AUTO_INCREMENT, so restored tables lack keys.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall include primary keys, other indexes, foreign keys and AUTO_INCREMENT settings in the structure of every exported table, in every export layout including separate files in an archive.

title: browse doesn't show all records
reason: The last-page jump is computed from an approximate row count, so it lands on the wrong page for large tables.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall compute the last-page position from an exact row count before offering a jump to the last page.

title: Open the Modify Row button to a new tab
reason: The Modify Row control is not a real link, so opening it in a new tab lands on the home page.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall implement every control that opens a page as a real link, so that opening it in a new tab or window shows the same page.

title: Enhance CSV export - include table structure
reason: Data-only formats such as CSV cannot include the table structure, and the legacy structure option is hidden.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a visible option in data-only export formats to include the table structure as a separate file or as an entry in the archive.

title: Enhance export: Write to local disk
reason: Saving an export to a file, both on the server and in the browser, is already specified.

title: Suggestions missing in autocomplete
reason: SQL autocompletion misses valid keyword and function suggestions for typed prefixes such as LE for LENGTH.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer keyword and built-in function completion for every keyword and function supported by the connected server version.

title: Confirm on insert new record
reason: Pressing Enter in an insert form submits the new row at once, so incomplete rows are inserted by accident.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not submit an insert form on Enter inside a field and shall require an explicit Insert button at the bottom of the form.

title: Two factor authentication should allow more than one U2F device
reason: Only one hardware U2F key can be registered per user, so no backup key exists if the key is lost.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall allow each user to register several second-factor credentials and to remove any one of them, as long as at least one remains.

title: Generate password complexity setting
reason: The generated password uses a fixed character set that fails stricter MySQL password policies, and the only fix is editing JavaScript.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let an administrator configure the character classes and minimum length of generated passwords so that they satisfy the target server's password policy.

title: Allow Signon login method to alter expiration time
reason: Signon session cookie lifetime is already a configurable parameter with safe defaults.

title: History table saving only last query in multi query statement
reason: Executing several statements at once stores only the last statement in the query history.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall record every statement of a multi-statement execution in the query history as its own entry.

title: inline editing in "select distinct" does not quote the values correctly
reason: Inline editing of a SELECT DISTINCT result builds an UPDATE with unquoted values and fails with an SQL error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not offer inline editing for result sets that have no unique row identity, and shall explain why instead of issuing an invalid statement.

title: restrict some types of uploads
reason: Uploaded file names are displayed without escaping, so a crafted name containing markup is rendered in the import page.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall escape uploaded file names everywhere they are displayed and shall reject file names that contain characters outside the allowed set.

title: Add possibility to empty BLOB fields
reason: Clearing a binary field is already possible through the NULL checkbox on the edit and insert forms.

title: Popup disappears too fast
reason: Informational popups disappear too quickly for their text to be read.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep informational messages visible until dismissed, or at least 10 seconds for short messages, and shall pause the timer while the pointer or focus is on the message.

title: Replication should not require AllowArbitraryServer
reason: Replication management is outside the current DBLoom scope, and the arbitrary-server switch is a legacy artefact of it.

title: Forcing 2FA for all users
reason: Enforcing 2FA for all users is covered by the 2FA enforcement policy.

title: Web page access is too slow, request improvement
reason: The report of slow page access gives no measurements or page names, so it cannot be decided.

title: Button to auto-fix partial LegacyAdmin conf storage
reason: Auto-creating the legacy configuration storage tables does not apply, since DBLoom does not use la_ tables.

title: Javascript error using timepicker
reason: Entering an unrecognised expression such as Timestamp() in a date field causes a JavaScript error instead of a validation message.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report unrecognised expressions in date and time input with a field-level validation message and no client-side exception.

title: Table grouping doesn't work
reason: Grouping tables in the navigation by a name separator is a useful navigation feature whose legacy version was broken by a regression.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall group tables in the navigation by a configurable name separator and shall show all tables when grouping is off.

title: Place buttons on more intutive positions
reason: Sidebar button order is specific to a legacy layout that DBLoom does not reuse.

title: HTML editor for text fields
reason: An integrated rich HTML editor for text fields adds stored markup and XSS exposure without a concrete need.

title: For Designer: retain Designer Page (for the session) after bouncing back to setup an index.
reason: Keeping the last Designer page for the session is a small usability improvement.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall remember the last Designer page the user opened for the duration of the session.

title: ANSI_QUOTES - Mysql 8: Relations (foreign key constraints) not shown
reason: Foreign-key relations are not shown when the server runs with ANSI_QUOTES, because the DDL is parsed under the wrong quoting rules.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall read foreign-key relations from INFORMATION_SCHEMA and shall not depend on the ANSI_QUOTES setting when it parses DDL.

title: X XPRIMARY clipboard doesn't work in text areas
reason: The SQL editor does not accept X11 primary-selection paste with the middle mouse button.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall accept X11 primary-selection paste in the SQL editor on Linux.

title: Warning with Jquery Version 5.1.0-dev
reason: jQuery version warnings concern the legacy PHP frontend dependencies.

title: Replacing JQuery UI
reason: Replacing jQuery UI is a framework chore that does not apply to DBLoom's TypeScript stack.

title: Bad Ui: Chart not responsive ( navigation -> status -> query statistics chart)
reason: The statistics chart does not resize to its container at medium widths.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall resize every chart to its container so that it stays readable down to a 320 px viewport without horizontal page scroll.

title: Request response error text
reason: Internal server errors are reported as "rejected" and as a lost connection, which is misleading and hides the real error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the server's actual error message and shall not imply a lost connection for an internal error.

title: Edit row in new tab destroys session in both tabs with multi server setup
reason: Opening a row edit in a new tab with several servers invalidates the session in both tabs, which logs users out unexpectedly.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the session valid in all open tabs when a new tab is opened and shall not invalidate other tabs except on explicit logout or session expiry.

title: Coding space in modal too small when extended right
reason: The complaint concerns the layout of a legacy modal editor that DBLoom does not reuse.

title: UI Issue: Idle kick destroys page with login form
reason: Session expiry showing the login form over a broken page is covered by the session-timeout re-login contract.

title: LegacyAdmin Logo not clickable
reason: The logo link problem is specific to a legacy theme that DBLoom does not reuse.

title: Non intuitive UI on search Results Page
reason: Expand and collapse controls on the search results page look like plain text and should be real buttons with visible affordance and keyboard access.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render every expand, collapse and toggle control as a button with a visible affordance and keyboard access.

title: There should be a quick guide for beginners (after installation process) and tips should also be shown after login
reason: A first-run guide and optional, dismissible usage tips are a reasonable onboarding feature.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a short first-run guide after installation and optional usage tips that the user can switch off.

title: Current Server list breaks per server "ssl" parameter when using SignON auth
reason: With several servers, the per-server TLS settings of the first configured server are applied at login, so the selected server can connect with the wrong TLS settings.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall use only the TLS settings of the target chosen for the session and shall never apply settings belonging to another configured target.

title: Foreign key check setting is not respected
reason: Suspension of foreign-key checks for destructive operations and their restoration are specified.

title: do not expose PMA_VERSION in requests
reason: The exact product version is included in asset URLs served to every visitor, which helps attackers target known flaws.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not reveal the exact product version in page source, asset URLs or HTTP headers served before login.

title: More performance, speed first
reason: The issue is a general performance tracking note with no concrete behaviour, and its suggested tools are PHP profilers.

title: Be more friendly with binary uuid
reason: Binary UUID primary keys display as raw hex, and a readable canonical form with a conversion function is a reasonable request.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall display BINARY(16) primary key values in canonical UUID form when they are valid UUIDs, and shall offer the raw form on request.

title: Lock tables does not work from legacyadmin.... But ok from SQL Client like SQLyog
reason: A LOCK TABLES statement typed in the SQL box is accepted but the lock is not kept, because the statement does not run on a connection bound to the session.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall run table locks requested in the SQL console on a connection bound to the user's session, shall release them on logout, timeout or explicit unlock, and shall show the lock state.

title: [shortcuts] keyboard shortcut to Clear MySQL command window?
reason: There is no keyboard shortcut to clear the SQL console output, a small and reasonable convenience.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide a configurable keyboard shortcut that clears the SQL console output.

title: relation between tables
reason: The relation dropdown shows each value twice and does not allow multiple selection for SET columns.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer each referenced value once in the relation dropdown and shall allow multiple selection when the target column is a SET.

title: Improvement to the "Get auto-saved query" UX
reason: The auto-saved query warning popup was removed in 6.0.

title: SQL history doesn't log generated queries
reason: Statements generated by the search, row edit and insert forms are not recorded in the history, which is fed only by the SQL box path.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall record every statement it executes in the query history, including statements generated by search, row edit and insert forms.

title: With long routines, error messages  can't be read
reason: Long echoed SQL pushes the error message out of view in the routine editor, so the user cannot read the error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the error message of a failed routine or SQL save above or beside the echoed statement, so that it stays visible without scrolling.

title: Setting ssl_ca results in OpenSSL error.
reason: Setting a CA certificate for the database TLS connection makes login fail with a generic OpenSSL error that does not explain the verification failure.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall verify the database server certificate against the configured CA, and on failure shall show the verification reason and the target name without exposing key material.

title: Register multiple FIDO2-Hardware keys
reason: Multiple passkeys and TOTP as alternative second factors are part of the decided scope.

title: Logged in to wrong server after session timeout
reason: After a session timeout the re-login can connect to the previously used server instead of the one the user selected.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall bind a re-login after session expiry to the target chosen on the login form and shall refuse to reuse the previous target when the choice differs.

title: Filters are applied after pagination in list of tables within database
reason: The table-list filter is applied after pagination, so matches on other pages are hidden and users may believe the data does not exist.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply a table name filter to the full table list before pagination and shall show the total number of matches.

title: batch modify rows in list view page
reason: The body contains only screenshots, so it is not clear which batch operation on list view rows is meant.

title: History tab
reason: A query history list with a cap and optional persistence per user is already specified.

title: Unable to order a SQL query
reason: Sorting a result by clicking a column rewrites the user's SQL with a wrapper that breaks when the query has subqueries or aliases.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall sort a result by wrapping the user query only when it is a single SELECT it can parse, and shall otherwise disable the sort control with a short explanation instead of sending a broken query.

title: Allow users to log in via auth_socket connection type
reason: auth_socket and unix_socket require the OS user of the web server to match the database user, which does not fit a self-hosted web tool connecting with configured credentials.

title: Search function within a DB
reason: The database-wide table search request has the same root cause as issue 16084 and is a duplicate of it.

title: Ignore ignored on insert
reason: The Ignore checkbox on the single-row insert form is not applied, so the INSERT is generated without IGNORE.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply the per-row Ignore option to the generated INSERT for single-row and multi-row inserts alike, and shall report how many rows were ignored.

title: Capturing “Delete” Keypress and remove selected elements
reason: Deleting selected rows with the keyboard Delete key is a reasonable UX request if the confirmation dialog is kept.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the Delete key start deletion of the selected rows in the browse grid, and shall still require an explicit confirmation before any row is removed.

title: Add integration for errors/CSP violation reports (eg. using sentry)
reason: CSP and client error reporting are already decided: the CSP report endpoint is same-origin and log-only, and third-party error reporting is dropped.

title: Exporting rows does not show that an error has occurred in a subquery
reason: A query error during an export silently produces a partial file with no error shown to the user.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall abort an export and report the error to the user when a statement or row fetch fails mid-stream, and shall never deliver a file that is silently partial.

title: MySQL 8.0.20 - INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE statements is now deprecated
reason: Deprecation of VALUES() in INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is a code-maintenance chore for LegacyAdmin's own statements with no visible user effect.

title: MySQL 8.0.1 - The deprecated PROCEDURE ANALYSE() syntax has been removed.
reason: PROCEDURE ANALYSE was removed in MySQL 8.0.1, below the MySQL 8.4 minimum, so there is nothing to support.

title: MySQL 8.0.3 - Removed functions
reason: Lists functions removed in MySQL 8.0.3, which are absent from the minimum supported server.

title: mysql.db table not updated when DROP database operation is used
reason: Dropping a database leaves its row in mysql.db, which later blocks reuse of the name; the expected cleanup is not confirmed.

title: Add security policy (SECURITY.md file) to repo
reason: Repository SECURITY.md disclosure policy, a project process item rather than product behaviour.

title: Add fail2ban usage documentation
reason: A documentation request for fail2ban brute-force protection; the missing control itself is already recorded.

title: LegacyAdmin works very slowly with large number of tables
reason: Slow listing with about 40000 tables is the scenario of the paged navigation tree.

title: implement Feature-Policy header
reason: A Feature-Policy header is requested.

title: Chosen label not shown on GIS-visualization.
reason: The GIS visualization ignores the selected label column unless the base map layer is enabled.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply the selected GIS label column whether or not a base map layer is shown.

title: Renaming a database, table, or column should adjust view definitions that reference that item
reason: Renaming a table, database or column leaves dependent views invalid, with no option to update their definitions.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall detect views that reference a renamed object and offer to update their definitions before the rename is applied.

title: View/Edit support for CHECK constraints
reason: A proposed DBLoom requirement already covers listing and editing CHECK constraints.

title: Routine export to include DROP
reason: Exporting selected routines from the routines list offers no DROP statement, unlike the database export.
