proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a DROP statement option when exporting selected routines.

title: Could the "Edit Routine" modal remember its last position and size?
reason: The routine editor does not keep its size and position between openings.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall remember the size and position of the routine editor per user.

title: Move Response's methods calls to controllers
reason: Refactoring of Response method calls in PHP controllers.

title: LOCK/UNLOCK commands in imported sql dumps files generate warnings
reason: Importing a mysqldump file with LOCK TABLES and engine options shows many server notes as warnings although the import succeeds.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show server notes from imported statements separately from errors and shall not present them as warnings for a successful import.

title: Move HTTP request superglobals access to controllers
reason: Refactoring of superglobal access in LegacyAdmin PHP controllers.

title: SQL query editor completion: Special characters in column names not supported
reason: Completion of column names with special characters inserts identifiers that are not quoted correctly.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall insert identifiers that contain special characters quoted with backticks when completing names in the SQL editor.

title: Obvious functions missing in type autocomplete suggestions
reason: SQL completion does not suggest built-in functions such as UNIX_TIMESTAMP.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer SQL keyword and built-in function completion matching the connected server version in the SQL editor.

title: Support hardware token and app 2FA simultanously
reason: Only one two-factor backend can be active per user, so a lost hardware key cannot be backed up by an authenticator app.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall allow a user to enrol more than one second factor and to remove a lost factor without losing access.

title: Store procedure runs but doesn't run it depends how to start it
reason: Routine execution with several result sets, the case described, is already specified.

title: Page selector of tables subtree in left panel randomly disappears
reason: The paginator of a searched table list disappears, so later pages cannot be reached.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep navigation pagination controls visible whenever a list has more items than fit on one page.

title: legacyadmin is no longer letting me set auto_increment value and VIEW
reason: The reporter cannot set AUTO_INCREMENT on a ZEROFILL table, but the report is labelled invalid and the cause is not clear.

title: Add "Table count", "Rows count" and "Size" columns to "DataBases" page
reason: The database list statistics mode already provides per-database statistics.

title: Display "Packed" for indexes fro MyISAM tables only
reason: The Packed option is displayed for InnoDB tables, where it has no effect.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show table options only where the table's storage engine supports them.

title: Have a small and empty version of LegacyAdmin
reason: Request for a minimal LegacyAdmin tarball, a packaging matter of the PHP product.

title: Changing a user's global privileges revokes all database-specific ones
reason: Saving global privileges revokes the account's database- and table-level grants, because the save runs REVOKE ALL before re-granting.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall change the global privileges of an account without revoking its database- or table-level grants.

title: All Privileges are revoked upon Global privilege change.
reason: Duplicate of #16446, the same global privilege change revoking database grants.

title: Session problem on two servers on one IP and two ports
reason: Two instances on the same host with different ports share the session cookie, so logging into one ends the session of the other.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall scope session and login cookies per instance so that two DBLoom instances on the same host or on different ports do not end each other sessions.

title: click on the database, Left navigation did not refresh
reason: The navigation tree does not refresh when a table is dropped outside the UI, so it keeps showing a deleted object.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide a manual refresh of the navigation tree and shall refresh it after every create or drop made in the UI.

title: [ANSI_QUOTES] Error when copying table - #1113 - a table must have at least 1 column
reason: Duplicate of an existing ANSI_QUOTES table-copy issue, as labelled in the report.

title: Support newer compressions like xz or zstd
reason: Import accepts only bzip2, gzip and zip compressed files, so xz and zstd dumps must be decompressed first.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall import xz and zstd compressed SQL files, detected by their magic bytes like the other supported compressed formats.

title: Import back JSON/LaTex/Word 2000 legacyadmin exports
reason: Asks to import LaTeX, Word 2000 and similar presentation-only exports, which are not reversible data formats.

title: Better phrasing for "Users table" in setup script
reason: Wording of a setup-script label, a translation and documentation matter.

title: Store proc doesn't work in legacyadmin but does work in command line
reason: A stored procedure with parameters fails in LegacyAdmin but works on the command line, and the failing statement is not identified in the report.

title: hide_db seems to not work
reason: The hide_db setting has no visible effect, and hidden databases remain in the navigation tree.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply hidden-database rules, as a single name or a regular expression, to the navigation tree, the database list and all database selectors.

title: [Mozilla Firefox] 5.0.4  right click copy in SQL
reason: Right-click copy and paste do not work in the SQL editor in Firefox.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the browser clipboard actions (copy, cut, paste) working in the SQL editor in all supported browsers.

title: Link to foreign records referencing a certain primary key / Inverse display of foreign key relations
reason: A user cannot see from a primary-key row which rows in other tables reference it, so inverse foreign-key browsing is missing.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show, for a selected row, the rows in other tables that reference it through foreign keys, with links to them.

title: Confirm before hiding tables or allow undo operation
reason: Hiding a table in the navigation tree happens with one click and offers no confirmation or undo.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall confirm or offer an undo for hiding a navigation item.

title: Security question for unsaved changes after save trigger
reason: After a trigger is saved successfully the browser still asks for confirmation on navigation because the unsaved-change lock is not cleared.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall clear the unsaved-changes state after a successful save so that no leave-page prompt appears.

title: TempDir is not accessible
reason: Request to ship an empty temp directory in the release snapshot; packaging and setup-notice matter, not DBLoom behaviour.

title: Errors copying database: multiple primary keys
reason: Copying a database fails with a multiple primary key error while copying table structures.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall copy database and table structures without adding a second primary key to a table and shall report any copy failure per object.

title: Designer should warn when trying to create relationships of different data types
reason: The Designer allows a foreign key between columns of different data types without any warning, and the server error is unclear.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall warn and ask for confirmation before creating a foreign key between columns whose data types differ.

title: Saving default transformation settings
reason: Reverting a preference to its default and saving stores a duplicated list value, so the option shows a literal local.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall store a reverted preference as its default value and shall never duplicate list values on save.

title: pma_tracking doesn't exist
reason: The spec already requires each feature to degrade when configuration storage tables are missing.

title: Implement sending breadcrumbs to the error reporting server
reason: Adds user action breadcrumbs to LegacyAdmin's remote error-report sender, a telemetry feature of the legacy reporting service.

title: ZEROFILL is deprecated and will be removed in MySQL
reason: ZEROFILL is deprecated since MySQL 8.0.17 and the column editor gives no warning when it is selected.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show a deprecation warning when a column is defined with ZEROFILL on a server that deprecates it.

title: Reflow issues (part 2)
reason: Layout reflow caused by inline-style computation in legacy Twig navigation templates of LegacyAdmin.

title: A PHP warning is given when the SQL server is shutdown or restarted
reason: When the database server is stopped while a query runs, the login page emits a raw PHP warning instead of a controlled error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report a lost or refused database connection as a controlled, user-readable error without exposing raw driver warnings.

title: How to Active Two-Factor Auth on legacyadmin
reason: Support question about installing Composer packages for two-factor authentication in the PHP application.

title: [tree] Unable to load a DB contents on another page
reason: Navigation search only finds databases on the currently loaded page, so a matching database on another page cannot be opened from the tree.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let navigation search find databases and tables across all result pages, not only the currently loaded page.

title: Empty String not working correctly when setting default.
reason: Duplicate of #16801, the same empty-string default quoting defect.

title: Quotes appear when field type is TEXT and I use default 'as defined'
reason: A TEXT column default entered as an empty string is shown and re-saved with extra quote characters, so the stored default changes on edit.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall store and display an empty-string column default as an empty string and shall not add quote characters when a column is edited and saved.

title: LegacyAdmin is logged out if opened in a new tab on Firefox
reason: SameSite cookie behaviour, which causes logouts when a link is opened from another context, is specified.

title: Default Date Format Transformation Format
reason: The date display format for transformations, including its default, is specified by the DateFormat transformation.

title: $cfg['TablePrimaryKeyOrder'] = 'desc';
reason: This is labelled a duplicate and concerns a configuration default for primary key ordering, already covered by FR-DTB-002.

title: Argument 1 passed to LegacyAdmin\DatabaseInterface::escapeString() must be of the type string, null given
reason: This is a PHP TypeError raised by a tracker helper when a value is null, specific to the PHP code.

title: IPv6 servers: don't enforce brackets
reason: A bare IPv6 server address is rejected in the server field and must be wrapped in square brackets.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall accept IPv6 server addresses with or without square brackets when entering a connection target.

title: Add ability to fix unit type of output numbers in single output block to not mix µs/ms/s and MiB/KiB in one interface table
reason: Numeric and size values in one column use different units, which makes comparing rows hard.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a per-column option to fix the display unit for numeric and size values so that all rows in a column share one unit.

title: [MariaDB 10.5] Privileges changes
reason: The privilege editor does not handle MariaDB 10.5 and later granular privileges.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show and grant MariaDB 10.5 and later granular privileges in the account privilege editor.

title: LegacyAdmin logs out if session folder has wrong permissions
reason: A session start failure must stop execution with a fatal error instead of silently logging the user out.

title: Add the Favorite Gold Star icon to the Nav Pane - like the Show/Hide option
reason: Favourite tables are listed in the navigation as a quick-access list, bounded by a setting.

title: Write documentation about how to write security rules
reason: This asks for documentation of web application firewall rules for the LegacyAdmin ruleset.

title: Support for MySQL/MariaDB roles
reason: Role-based authentication and MariaDB role handling are specified as upstream changes.

title: Designer should warn if trying to define a new relationship reference using a foreign key in a MyISAM database.
reason: The designer does not warn when a relationship uses a MyISAM table, where the foreign key is silently ignored.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall warn in the relationship editor and before executing a foreign-key change when either table uses a non-InnoDB engine, because the constraint would not be enforced.

title: ConfigStorage does not work as expected/I don't see the history of queries
reason: This is a support question about query history not appearing in a configuration-storage setup.

title: [GoogleAppEngine] V5.1.0 - Failed to set session cookie. Maybe you are using HTTP instead of HTTPS.
reason: Secure session cookie handling for HTTPS and proxied requests is specified.

title: Delete button for table row is triggered without confirmation dialogue when a warning dialogue is visible
reason: Destructive row delete requires an explicit confirmation, and the SPEC requires a server-side two-step token rather than a JavaScript dialog.

title: Query results are sorted ASC when ORDER BY is not specified
reason: Row order without ORDER BY is unspecified SQL behaviour chosen by the MySQL optimizer, not an application defect.

title: Table copy operation is incomplete for larger data sets
reason: A table copy of a large table can silently produce fewer rows than the source, and no row count check is specified.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall compare source and target row counts after a table copy and report any mismatch as an error.

title: Pagination doesn't work as expected for performance_schema database
reason: Total-count computation, the fast count and last-page navigation are specified.

title: Ubuntu focal: `Unknown named parameter $$dbi`
reason: This is a packaging breakage in an Ubuntu PPA build with a Symfony version mismatch.

title: [simulation] For Insert, Where clause: IS NULL returns no results
reason: A simulated UPDATE with IS NULL returns no rows, and the text does not show enough to decide whether the simulation or the autocomplete is at fault.

title: Pagination doesn't work as expected when all rows from last page are deleted
reason: Position clamping after all rows on the last page are deleted is specified.

title: Changing Value in enum column type is not changing when we have space at the front in the value
reason: Leading spaces in ENUM values are not kept or changed when the column definition is edited.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep leading and trailing spaces in ENUM and SET member values exactly as entered and shall apply later edits to them.

title: LegacyAdmin storage detection false positive working table & using the wrong db
reason: Configuration storage detection can report a false positive when a same-named table exists in another database.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall check configuration-storage tables only in the configured storage database, never in the currently selected database.

title: 5.1.1 Memory limit causes LegacyAdmin to crash
reason: The process memory limit is specified as an environment-only setting.

title: Add Edit, Pagination, and export handling-options for multi-statement queries
reason: Pagination and export re-run only the final SELECT of a multi-statement query, so earlier session variables are lost and the results differ.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall run a multi-statement script once and use its results for display, pagination and export, and shall not re-run only the final SELECT.

title: Add support to login with Keycloak
reason: OpenID Connect as an alternative to local passwords is specified as an open requirement.

title: Ajax doesn't handle well HTTP response status codes different than 200
reason: Structured AJAX error messages that include the status code are specified.

title: Mention the database name in some errors.
reason: Import errors such as table already exists do not name the target database, which can confuse imports into the wrong schema.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall name the target database and table in import errors such as table already exists.

title: Databases not shown when DisableIS set to true
reason: The DisableIS fallback is a legacy metadata path, and DBLoom targets MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 10.11 with information_schema.

title: Feature request: Think about built in GDPR quick actions
reason: This is a GDPR quick-action feature request marked invalid, and it is out of scope for a database admin tool.

title: Zip Decompression not found during setup
reason: This is a PHP zip_open deprecation warning shown by the legacy setup page.

title: Allow authenticators to provide username for saving settings.
reason: Keeping user settings under a separate identity from the database account is an open conflict in the SPEC.

title: Show hidden navigation tree items no vertical scroll
reason: The unhide-items dialog cannot scroll to items below the viewport when many items are hidden.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the unhide-items dialog scrollable and within the viewport for any number of hidden items.

title: Hidden tables don't flow into previous tree pages
reason: Hidden navigation items still count toward the navigation page size, so pages show fewer visible items than expected.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall exclude hidden navigation items from page-size calculations so that each navigation page shows a full page of visible items.

title: Support ALTER EVENT
reason: Replacing an event by drop and recreate, which can leave a gap, is recorded as a best-effort legacy behaviour.

title: Page-related settings modal is smaller in size on performance_schema table
reason: The size of the page-related settings modal is covered by the modal size and minimum height requirement.

title: Incorrect format parameter error after page-related settings are applied
reason: The form-resubmission error and CSS corruption come from legacy server-rendered settings forms and console handling.

title: Uncaught InternalError: too much recursion and Uncaught DOMException: An exception was thrown
reason: The too-much-recursion error comes from a legacy JavaScript column-index preview and is specific to that implementation.

title: Redoing column visibility / order property to keep it while tables changes
reason: Saved column order and visibility are deleted on every table structure change, not only for columns that were removed.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep saved column order and visibility for columns that still exist after a table structure change and remove only the entries for dropped columns.

title: Implements ed25519 authentication method
reason: Accounts that use the client_ed25519 authentication plugin cannot be used to connect.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall connect to accounts that use the client_ed25519 authentication plugin on MariaDB, or show a clear unsupported-plugin message that names the plugin.

title: LegacyAdmin (5.1.1) takes long time to import
reason: Time-limit handling for long imports and exports is specified; the throughput question is tuning support.

title: LEGACYADMIN POST request with HTTP ORIGIN header set to null - does not work behind Azure Web App with App Service built-in authentication (EasyAuth)
reason: This is a workaround for an Azure App Service authentication proxy that rejects null Origin headers, changed by editing PHP header code.

title: Incomplete exports without error or warning when `max_execution_time` is set
reason: An export silently contains only the rows read before the server max_execution_time aborts a SELECT, with no error or warning.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall detect a SELECT aborted by a server-side statement timeout during an export and fail the export or mark the output as incomplete, never silently.

title: Enabling LEGACYADMIN Logging & Fail2ban Default Filter
reason: Authentication failure logging to syslog for fail2ban integration is specified.

title: Password generation should satisfy mySQL validate password plugin settings or at least show them
reason: Suggested passwords are not checked against the server validate_password policy, so generated passwords can be rejected.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall generate suggested passwords that satisfy the target server's validate_password policy, or display the policy requirements next to the password field.

title: The selected user was not found in the privilege table.
reason: The broken user link on the Processes page is listed as a required upstream fix.

title: Question regarding MySQL restart vs server reboot
reason: The text asks whether a server restart or reboot should log the user out, and that cannot be decided from the title and body.

title: [shortcuts] CTRL-f causes unexpected behaviors
reason: Single-key and Ctrl-modified shortcuts that switch tabs and discard typed SQL are specified, with the modifier question left open.

title: Links to tables have missing database
reason: Table links generated from a server-level SQL result lose the database name and fail when clicked.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall attach the database name to every table link generated from a result set, or render the link disabled when the database cannot be determined.

title: Tables are not sortable by clicking on column headers.
reason: Column header click sorting is specified as a result-grid requirement.

title: Filtering broken when table have a primary key
reason: Filtering a table with a primary key returns no rows even though the matching row exists.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall return the rows that match the browse filter on primary-key columns with the same result as the equivalent SQL WHERE clause.

title: #1054 - Unknown column 'undefined' in 'where clause' and #1064 - You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version for the right syntax to use near
reason: Result actions and click-through use column names parsed from SQL text, so aggregate expressions such as COUNT(*) break the actions and the generated WHERE clause.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall take result column identity from server result metadata, not from parsing the SQL text.

title: Uncaught TypeError: can't access property "split", string is undefined
reason: Formatting a very large SQL statement hits a parser time limit and returns non-JSON output that breaks the client.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall return a structured error when SQL formatting exceeds its time or size limit and shall never return non-JSON responses to JSON endpoints.

title: Cannot create table #1171 - All parts of a PRIMARY KEY must be NOT NULL; if you need NULL in a key, use UNIQUE instead
reason: Primary key versus unique index handling in index DDL is specified, including the PRIMARY naming rule.

title: LegacyAdmin resets session data when server reaches maximum concurrent connections
reason: When the target server reports too many connections, the monitor page logs the user out and discards the session.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the user's application session when the target server refuses a new connection, and shall show the connection error on the page.

title: Adding subquery into select list causes fatal error
reason: Valid SELECT statements with a scalar subquery in the select list cause a fatal error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall execute valid SELECT statements with scalar subqueries in the select list and report any server error as a query error.

title: New Window button opens an error after import or drop
reason: The New Window popup button is a legacy convenience whose broken links after import are not worth porting.

title: Do a "query by example" (wildcard: "%") won't collapse sometimes when using search
reason: The query-by-example panel does not always collapse after a search, and the reporter cannot reproduce it.

title: Indexes on table creation don't work as expected
reason: Index DDL generation, including index types for new tables, is specified.

title: First day of calendar has an incorrect value and You do not have necessary privileges to create a database named 'legacyadmin'
reason: First-day-of-week localisation is specified; the storage-database privilege message is only partly covered by the setup requirements.

title: Multiline on textarea doesn't work if string has multiple spaces
reason: Textarea values lose repeated spaces, so multi-line text is saved and inserted with missing spaces.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall store textarea input exactly as entered, including repeated and trailing spaces.

title: iconv(): Detected an illegal character in input string
reason: Charset conversion errors on a binary upload surface as a PHP notice rather than a clear import error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report a charset conversion failure during import as a readable error naming the file and the chosen charset, and shall create no objects.

title: Importing a CSV file doesn't have enough checks
reason: CSV parsing and validation before parsing is specified, which covers rejecting a non-CSV file.

title: Back button from another theme
reason: After a failed import, the back button shows a page in the theme of another earlier session.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render any page returned from browser history with the theme currently selected by the user.

title: Loading notification doesn't dissaper
reason: Session-timeout handling in the UI, including the loading notification, is specified.

title: CodeMirror hint box should be wider
reason: The SQL autocomplete popup is too narrow, and column names overlap their types.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall size the SQL autocomplete popup so that column names and types do not overlap.

title: Unable to make primary key in structure section (more button)
reason: The more-actions menu in the structure view cannot be reached, so the user cannot make a column the primary key.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep every row action in the table structure view reachable at all supported viewport widths.

title: Downloading a database with GZIP compression from LegacyAdmin returns uncompressed files
reason: The gzip download problem is a Firefox-side regression that was closed as a duplicate.

title: Logging the SQL host on the authentication log
reason: The authentication log does not record which target server a login was for, which matters when several servers share one user name.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall include the target server identifier and the client address in each authentication log entry.

title: stored procedure is missing support for charset collation
reason: Routines cannot be created with a character set or collation, so collation mismatches produce errors.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer character set and collation options when creating or editing routines and shall preserve them on save.

title: GIS visualisation ends up in a very high cost query
reason: The GIS visualisation runs an unbounded SELECT * instead of applying the row limit.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply the configured row limit to every query issued by the GIS visualisation.

title: legacyadmin takes a long time to load .sql
reason: Slow SQL import on newer PHP versions is a PHP runtime performance report that does not map to DBLoom's design.

title: Access denied to "SHOW MASTER LOGS" at every login/logout
reason: Each login and logout issues SHOW MASTER LOGS, which writes an access denied entry to the server error log for limited users.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall issue binary-log listing statements only for accounts that hold the required privilege, so that login and logout create no access denied log entries.

title: Access denied to "SHOW MASTER STATUS"
reason: A non-privileged user triggers SHOW MASTER STATUS on every Status and Databases page, which fills the server error log with access denied messages.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall check the required privilege or server role before issuing replication or binary-log status statements, so that no access denied errors reach the server log.

title: SignonSession cookie not removed on logOut
reason: The signon cookie survives logout, so the back button or a later request logs the user back in without credentials.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall invalidate the server-side session and clear all session and auth cookies on logout, so that back navigation or a replayed request cannot reuse them.

title: Mbstring polyfill from Symfony causing 99% CPU usage during CSV import.
reason: A slow Symfony mbstring polyfill loop under PHP 8.0 is a PHP library issue.

title: legacyadmin 5.1.3 connot edit DB/Tables/Row
reason: The report mixes a 5.1.3 environment, a password-policy problem and a 2FA problem, and cannot be decided from the title and body.

title: USE command not working from within a database
reason: A USE statement in the SQL box does not change the database used by the following statements, so later statements run against the wrong schema.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply a USE statement in the SQL editor to all following statements of the same run and to the displayed database.

title: A cheat sheet should be added to help with theme development
reason: A theme-development cheat sheet is a legacy developer chore for the PHP theme system.

title: Ctrl+Left/Right inside a field editor overrides common "go to next word" behavior
reason: Ctrl+Left and Ctrl+Right are captured by the keyboard-shortcut handling, and the modifier decision is recorded as an open point.

title: big trouble using legacyadmin with large databases with 15k tables. Any configuration advice?
reason: Opening a database with about 15k tables runs one metadata query per table, causing very long server queries.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall load table metadata for a database in a fixed number of queries per page, not one query per table.

title: It is not possible to set password for legacyadmin user using configuratin wizard
reason: The password strength check rejects passwords that the server's validate_password policy accepts.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not reject a password that the server's validate_password policy accepts and shall show the policy's own message when it rejects one.

title: Unable to un fold the tree
reason: With a navigation filter active, the expand and unfold control stops working.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the expand and collapse controls of the navigation tree working while a filter is active.

title: Copy table should also copy foreign keys (and rename them ?)
reason: The copy-table phases, including foreign key constraints in the verification, are specified.

title: Multiple PHP warnings when removing twig folder
reason: PHP warnings from a deleted Twig cache and changed file permissions are specific to the legacy PHP template setup.

title: Add SHOW_ROUTINE global privilage option
reason: The privilege editor does not offer the SHOW_ROUTINE dynamic privilege, which would let a user see routine definitions without global SELECT.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer the SHOW_ROUTINE privilege in the privilege editor when the server supports it.

title: autoincrement reset itself /  deleting entry manually from LegacyAdmin
reason: The reported AUTO_INCREMENT reset is a server or hosting-side InnoDB behaviour and a support question.

title: Uncaught DOMException: Failed to execute 'get' on 'IDBObjectStore': The parameter is not a valid key.
reason: Browser-side storage is restricted, so the IndexedDB key error on designer save is avoided by design.

title: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value') and Undefined index: pred_hostname
reason: The privilege-edit submit path and the pred_hostname mapping are specified.

title: Sort Columns in the Sidebar
reason: Sidebar column lists are sorted alphabetically instead of by ordinal position, and the MUL key label is unclear.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall list table columns in the navigation tree in ordinal position by default and shall label index types with descriptive names.

title: Copy/Move Column
reason: Users cannot copy or move one or more columns to another table without dropping and re-adding them manually.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user copy or move one or more columns from one table to another, including their data, after a confirmation step.

title: No QR code appearing in settings
reason: The 2FA QR code SVG uses a locale-dependent decimal comma in a transform attribute, which produces a blank image.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall generate QR code markup with locale-independent numeric formatting and shall verify that the code renders.

title: TypeError: LegacyAdmin\Export::getFilenameAndMimetype(): Argument #5 ($filenameTemplate) must be of type string, null given
reason: Exporting a database with thousands of tables fails with a TypeError because the request exceeds an input-count limit.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export databases with thousands of tables and shall report any request-size failure as a readable error.

title: When viewing foreign keys, database name is truncated for SHOW TABLE STATUS
reason: Identifier quoting in SHOW TABLE STATUS is required to go through one central, tested quoting function, which prevents the hyphen truncation.

title: Timepicker (jQuery-UI)
reason: A jQuery-UI timepicker replacement discussion is specific to the jQuery stack that DBLoom does not use.

title: Left nav refreshes after accessing a table
reason: The navigation tree reloads on its own after a table is opened, discarding the user's database search and expansion.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not reload or reset the navigation tree state when the user opens a table.

title: Execute button disappears on creating new PROCEDURE when removing last input parameter on LegacyAdmin 5.2.0
reason: The Execute button disappears from the routine editor when the last parameter is removed, so a parameterless procedure cannot be saved.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the routine save and execute controls visible for routines with zero parameters.

title: Backslash being added to database names when granting privileges to a user
reason: Database names containing underscores are saved in privilege grants with a backslash escape that shows up in the UI as literal backslashes.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall store database names in privilege grants without display-level backslash escaping and shall escape `_` and `%` only in the generated GRANT statement.

title: UI/UX regression: Missing tbl_group link in navigation tree for groups
reason: Clicking a navigation-tree group label to filter by its prefix was removed, although the tbl_group URL parameter still works.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user filter the navigation tree to a table-name prefix group by activating the group label.

title: valid query using IS NULL: no auto-suggestion and returns no results
reason: The "no results" comes from an UPDATE that matched no rows, and the missing NULL keyword autocomplete is a minor editor detail.

title: Hide confirmation request if "Rollback when finished"
reason: The rollback-when-finished setting is not shown in the DML confirmation dialog, so users confirm without knowing whether rollback is active.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the current rollback-when-finished state in the confirmation dialog before executing DML statements.

title: Display output of `DELETE … RETURNING …`
reason: MariaDB DELETE ... RETURNING output is not displayed and the RETURNING keyword is not highlighted.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall display the rows returned by DELETE and UPDATE statements with a RETURNING clause on MariaDB servers that support it.

title: GitHub Action workflow thats shows the output changes for JavaScript
reason: Developer CI workflow for the legacy JavaScript build.

title: Semicolon repeatedly suffixed onto SQL if query ends in comment
reason: Re-running an edited statement that ends in a comment appends a semicolon each time.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the SQL text of a statement unchanged when it is edited and re-run, including a trailing comment.

title: Error message: error (rejected) is reported when I select a table randomly and click SQL.
reason: An error is reported after random table selection and SQL click, but the body and screenshots do not show the cause.

title: Advisor: Suboptimal caching method VS The query cache is not enabled
reason: The advisor reports a suboptimal caching method while the query cache is disabled, which is a misleading rule condition.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not raise a query-cache advisory when the server reports the query cache as disabled.

title: Japanese characters are garbled when exported in SQL format.
reason: SQL export writes some Japanese characters as broken bytes, which indicates a charset conversion or chunking defect.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall write SQL export files in UTF-8 without splitting multi-byte characters so that non-ASCII text round-trips unchanged.

title: Provide a way to either forward the hostname to mysql or check if host is correct before allowing login.
reason: MySQL already enforces the host part of an account at login, so the requested host check in LegacyAdmin would duplicate server behaviour.

title: Undefined index: Key_block_size
reason: PHP notice from legacy index-option code on the master branch that the rewrite does not reproduce.

title: No change after permission revoke
reason: Unticking privileges reports success but the REVOKE has no effect on the server.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall verify privilege changes against the server grants and report an error instead of success when a GRANT or REVOKE has no effect.

title: PHP error on try to create the legacyadmin without SQL files on disk
reason: PHP TypeError caused by missing setup SQL files in a packaged installation.

title: Export query result ignores query LIMIT
reason: Exporting selected results of a LIMITed query ignores the LIMIT and exports all rows.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export exactly the rows returned by the executed query, including its LIMIT clause, when query results are exported.

title: i've got legacyadmin error on legacyadmin 5.3 snapshot for y wordpress website under debian and using nginx 1.23
reason: Installation support question for WordPress under Debian and nginx.

title: Index for table 'global_priv' is corrupt
reason: The superuser probe that produces the index-corrupt warning on mysql.user is specified.

title: No privileges to create databases message not showing on master
reason: Hiding the create-database form without CREATE privilege is specified.

title: `DatabaseName` and `TableName` should be used for `$db` and `$table`
reason: PHP class refactoring request for typed database and table names.

title: on ubuntu in  chrome, there is an issue with ERD if you click both buttons at once on the entity
reason: Designer drag behaviour with two mouse buttons is an edge case of the legacy jQuery designer on an old release.

title: Search for fields (columns) within the search tool
reason: Users want the search tool to find columns as well as tables across a database.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let users search for column names across the tables of a database from the search tool.

title: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES doesn't work with "_" in database name
reason: GRANT escaping of underscore in database names is the MySQL wildcard escape, and the report is a support question rather than a defect.

title: Request superglobals in controllers should be replaced with `ServerRequest` object
reason: Refactoring request to replace PHP superglobals in legacy controllers.

title: Years are seen wrong by date picker
reason: Dates with years below 100 are displayed with a century inferred from two digits, so year 0035 shows as 1935.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall display and parse DATE and DATETIME values with years 0000 to 9999 exactly as stored, without two-digit or century inference in the date picker.

title: Some tables in the database do not allow for "click" column sorting
reason: Some tables do not sort on header click, but the cause (missing index, column type, or client state) cannot be decided from the text.

title: Update documentation on creating custom themes
reason: Documentation request for legacy SCSS theming.

title: [Feature] Execute multiple queries from the query textbox inside one transaction.
reason: Users want several DML statements in the query box executed in one transaction that is rolled back on error; the spec only has a single-statement rollback helper.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer running a multi-statement SQL script in one transaction that is rolled back when any statement fails.

title: Virtuality is all messed up when chancing the column afterwards.
reason: Changing a generated column's name also changes its VIRTUAL or STORED generation, which corrupts the column definition.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall preserve the generation expression and VIRTUAL or STORED kind of a generated column when only its name is changed.

title: Query builder does not include sort order
reason: The query builder omits the ORDER BY clause for criteria that have a sort direction.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall include the sort direction of each query-builder criteria column as an ORDER BY clause in the generated SELECT.

title: @DATABASE@ is empty when exporting?
reason: With the @DATABASE@ token, a multi-database export produces an empty database name in the file name.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall substitute the name of each database into the @DATABASE@ filename token when several databases are exported in one run.

title: Paging issue with Stored Procedure Results
reason: Result sets returned by CALL statements are not paged; all rows appear at once while the label says a page size.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply the row limit and paging to result sets returned by CALL statements in the SQL editor.

title: Extra table header cell incorrectly added
reason: Extra empty header cell comes from legacy browse-table markup that a new grid implementation does not reproduce.

title: Copy Query to Clipboard Feature from the Modal-Box.
reason: Users want a copy-to-clipboard button for the SQL shown in destructive-action confirmation dialogs.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a copy-to-clipboard button for the SQL text shown in destructive-action confirmation dialogs.

title: A PRIMARY key should not be possible to rename
reason: The index rename action is offered for the PRIMARY key and produces an error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not offer a rename action for the PRIMARY key index.

title: Strange behavior of `navbar-collapse` for devices smaller than 992px.
reason: Navbar collapse rendering problem is specific to the legacy Bootstrap and Darkwolf themes.

title: Tooltip is not present for datetime and timestamp fields
reason: Date and time tooltips are specified through the central tooltip function; the missing tooltip for datetime fields is covered by that requirement.

title: Click does not close notification that the table name is copied
reason: Notification auto-close and dismissal behaviour is specified for ajax messages.

title: Settings for "Full texts", "show BLOB contents" etc. get reset at every change of page or sorting
reason: Display options for full text, BLOB contents and character limits reset when the user changes page or sort order, although the spec remembers them per query.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the full-text, BLOB-display and character-limit options of a result view when the user changes page, row count or sort order.

title: remembering table sorting issue
reason: Remembered sort order for single-table SELECTs is specified, including its storage and reapplication rules.

title: What's the purpose of DisableIS?
reason: Question about why the legacy DisableIS option exists, answered by the target design that always uses INFORMATION_SCHEMA.

title: Select arrow doesn't hide the content when direction is different
reason: Select arrow styling issue depends on the Bootstrap CSS of the legacy theme and is waiting on upstream.

title: Click on table prefix doesn't work anymore
reason: Clicking a grouped table or database prefix in the navigation tree no longer lists its members; grouping is specified but not the click target.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall make a navigation group label selectable so that the main panel lists all databases or tables in that group.

title: Sql connection errors
reason: One unreachable configured server makes the whole application fail to load instead of only that server failing.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the other configured servers usable and show a per-server error when one configured server cannot be reached.

title: #1054 - Unbekanntes Tabellenfeld '0x' in field list
reason: The question asks how to insert hex WKB into a POINT column but the reported error may be a parser or user SQL problem that the text does not settle.

title: Exporting user accounts does not contain `CREATE USER`
reason: User export emits only GRANT statements without CREATE USER, so the output cannot be imported into MySQL 8 servers.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall prefix each exported user account with a CREATE USER statement compatible with MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 10.11 before its GRANT statements.

title: renaming database does not copy views in new database and throws error
reason: Database rename and copy with view stand-ins and view handling after tables is specified.

title: Escape key hides the Create view dialog, it cannot be accessed
reason: Pressing Escape while autocomplete is open also closes the create-view dialog, leaving it unreachable.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall close only the autocomplete popup on Escape and keep the create-view dialog open and focused.

title: My views are getting access denied for all users
reason: Views become inaccessible for all users after a few days, but the cause (privileges, definer, or server state) cannot be decided from the text.

title: ArbitraryServer need global server directive ?
reason: Support question about legacy arbitrary-server configuration directives.

title: Option to Merge two or more database with similar entries
reason: The title asks for merging databases with similar entries but the body gives no concrete behaviour.

title: Advisory System
reason: Advisor rules for query cache fragmentation are specified, and the false-positive report falls under the same rule set.

title: value of foreign key to show onhover
reason: Users ask for the display column of a referenced row to be shown on hover over a foreign-key value; the spec only has a display column for foreign-value pickers.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the configured display column of the referenced row in a tooltip when the user hovers a foreign-key value in the browse grid.

title: Deprecated PASSWORD() function
reason: Deprecated PASSWORD() use for user passwords is already specified with server-version branching and the MySQL 8 exception.

title: Fatal error when exporting a database with many tables
reason: Exporting a database with about 15,000 tables hits a fatal execution-time error and produces no output.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export databases with very large table counts without a fixed run-time limit and report progress while exporting.

title: Error while exporting a database with tables that cannot be read
reason: A table that cannot be read aborts the whole database export instead of being skipped with a warning.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall skip and report objects that cannot be read during database export and continue with the rest.

title: Dropdown in "Create relation" to Select2 Widget
reason: A plain dropdown for the referenced table in relation creation is hard to use with more than 50 tables.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide a searchable table picker in relation dialogs when a database has many tables.

title: LegacyAdmin does not stream the export data when "Add CREATE PROCEDURE / FUNCTION / EVENT statement" is enabled
reason: Export with routine definitions enabled collects everything before streaming, so long exports can hit the proxy timeout.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall start streaming export output before routine and event definitions are collected.

title: Submit button not working for LegacyAdmin 5.1.2
reason: Support question about a Firefox submit button in an old release, marked invalid.

title: 'Export' option doesn't appear when querying data using with
reason: The export option is missing for result sets from WITH statements because only SELECT-prefixed queries are treated as row-returning.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall treat WITH statements that return rows like SELECT, offering result export and grid display.

title: HTTP 400 Bad Request
reason: Creating a view without a selected database returns HTTP 400 instead of a readable message.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall reject view creation without a selected database with a readable message.

title: Date Picker calendar defaults to 1900 after first click
reason: Labelled duplicate of another date picker report.

title: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')
reason: Saving a designer layout as a page and saving it again throws a JavaScript TypeError on the trim of an undefined value.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall save a designer layout as a named page and re-save it without a client-side error.

title: Online/Instant Foreign Key updates
reason: Changing foreign keys runs ALTER TABLE with checks on, locking tables; users want a choice to disable checks for such changes.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user choose whether a foreign-key change runs with foreign key checks disabled and shall show the lock level the change will take.

title: ErrorException: session_start()
reason: PHP session file-permission error specific to the PHP session store, not to DBLoom's design.

title: Please add "auto-refresh" feature to the table view
reason: Users ask for an automatic refresh of table data, for example to follow application logs.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer an optional auto-refresh interval for browse results.

title: Manual installation does not work correctly!
reason: Manual installation support question for an old PHP-based release.

title: Extra columns when running a LIMIT query
reason: A LIMIT query adds four empty header columns to the result table.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render result-table headers only for the columns the result set contains.

title: Obvious suggestions missing in autocomplete
reason: Autocomplete does not suggest built-in SQL functions such as NOW or UNIX_TIMESTAMP, which users expect.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer MySQL and MariaDB built-in function names and keywords, with their call syntax, as autocomplete suggestions.

title: Initialization fails if `mkdir()` is disabled.
reason: When a temporary directory cannot be created, a secondary error hides the real cause of the startup failure.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report the first startup failure with its root cause and shall not replace it with secondary errors.

title: Filter tables - "|" character
reason: The table filter accepts only one term, and a separator such as a pipe to match several tables would help.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the table filter match several terms, for example separated by a pipe character.

title: No error messages when creating a view with a conflicting name
reason: Creating a view with a conflicting name shows no error message, so the user does not learn why nothing was created.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the database error message when creating or altering a view fails.

title: Create view button doesn't unbind jQuery events
reason: Repeating the create-view action sends a second backend request for one submission, because event handlers accumulate.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall send one create-view request per user submission even after the dialog has been opened repeatedly.

title: Rename database has multiple bugs
reason: Database rename mishandles the table names 0 and all-digit names because of PHP truthiness checks.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall accept the identifiers 0 and all-digit names in rename and copy operations without relying on truthiness checks.

title: Undefined array key 0
reason: After a database copy and reload, a selected database that no longer exists triggers undefined-key warnings in the breadcrumb.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall treat a selected database that no longer exists as unselected and show the server view without warnings.

title: Database and table name encoding doesn't work in Designer
reason: Non-ASCII database and table names are double-encoded in designer links, so the target page is not found.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall encode non-ASCII database and table names exactly once in every URL, form and link.

title: Max length is ignored for input values
reason: Input fields ignore the declared maximum length, so users can type values that the column cannot store.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall enforce each column declared length in edit forms before submission.

title: autocomplete doesn't come out on mobile
reason: SQL autocomplete never appears in Android Chrome unless desktop mode is enabled.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide SQL autocompletion on touch-screen mobile browsers.

title: arm32v6 tests are failing with bus error
reason: Bus errors in the PHP 32-bit CI test job.

title: Order by DESC as default on first click on column
reason: The first click on a sortable primary-key column sorts ascending, while users usually want descending for ids.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer for the primary-key column a first sort click that reverses the default sort direction.

title: Improve loading time for autocompletion
reason: Loading the schema metadata for autocompletion takes minutes on every return to the SQL editor.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall cache schema metadata for SQL autocompletion per connection and refresh it in the background instead of reloading it on each visit.

title: Feature request : Bug encountered when filtering on tables
reason: Labelled duplicate of another report about table filtering.

title: Add documentation related to the public directory
reason: Documentation request for a PHP public directory introduced by an upstream pull request.

title: Navigation panel settings icon issues
reason: The page settings icon appears on tabs where it does not apply and the page settings modal can be empty.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the page settings control only on pages that have page-specific settings and shall always list those settings in the modal.

title: Internal error: TypeError: `LegacyAdmin\Encoding::convertString()`: Return value must be of type `string`, `bool` returned
reason: An import with an invalid byte sequence for the declared charset makes the encoding conversion fail and leaves an internal error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report invalid byte sequences in an imported file with their position and shall not continue the import with corrupted data.

title: TypeError: preg_replace(): Argument #3 ($subject) must be of type array|string, null given
reason: A column whose data type the tool does not know causes a browse error and a failed search page instead of being shown with its raw type.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall display columns whose data type it does not recognise with the type name reported by the server and keep the table page usable.

title: TypeError: LegacyAdmin\Controllers\Export\ExportController::setGlobalsFromRequest(): Argument #1 ($postParams) must be of type array, null given
reason: Restarting a cancelled export fails with a TypeError because the request parameters are not re-created.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall answer a repeated export request that lacks its parameters with a clear message instead of an internal error.

title: Uncaught TypeError: right-hand side of 'in' should be an object, got undefined
reason: Fast tab clicks racing in-flight requests are covered by the rule that aborts or refuses concurrent page loads.

title: Fatal error: Failed to set session cookie. Maybe you are using HTTP instead of HTTPS to access LegacyAdmin
reason: The cookie flags, cookie name and HTTPS detection behind the HTTP session-cookie failure are specified.

title: LegacyAdmin\Dbal\InvalidDatabaseName: The database name must be a non-empty string.
reason: A saved bookmark that runs a server-level statement fails with an invalid database name error because it is forced into a database context.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall run a saved bookmark that has no database context without requiring a database to be selected.

title: Manually doing "SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=OFF" in the SQL tab
reason: A SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=OFF typed in the SQL tab does not affect a later ALTER in the same submission, so the online foreign-key change fails.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall run all statements of one SQL-editor submission on one session so that session settings such as FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS apply to the statements that follow them.

title: Significant performance degradation  on conditional queries in 5.2
reason: The report gives no reproduction, only that adding a trivially true condition makes queries slow, which may relate to the total-count rewrite but cannot be decided from the text.

title: Functional Index In Exports
reason: The export writes a placeholder instead of the full expression of a functional index key part, so the recreated index differs.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export the full expression of every functional index key part in generated DDL.

title: Fatal error
reason: A PHP execution-time support question with no DBLoom-relevant behaviour.

title: shell script cannot read file
reason: A support question about a classroom shell script that cannot read a file.

title: Theme color mode can't be changed
reason: Colour-mode switching is a 6.0 feature already specified as a requirement and a setting.

title: Ubuntu 18.04  with Blowfish key included -- Warning: The configuration file needs a valid key for cookie encryption
reason: The blowfish secret length check and the cookie-encryption key rules are specified.

title: Potential property access on `undefined`
reason: A JavaScript code-quality refactoring with no user-visible behaviour in the legacy front end.

title: Issue when reordering routine parameters
reason: In the routine editor, dragging parameters shifts the layout and the first and last positions cannot be reached.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall allow any routine parameter to be moved to any position without shifting the layout.

title: MySQLTutorial classicmodels sample database fails to load due to LegacyAdmin (?) ignoring MySQL conditional comments
reason: The legacy import parser drops MySQL conditional comments, so dumps that rely on them (for example classicmodels) fail to load.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall send MySQL conditional comments in imported SQL to the server unchanged so that the server applies them.

title: Toggle column visibility menu does not scroll to the end
reason: The column visibility dropdown of a wide table cannot scroll, so columns beyond the visible list cannot be reached.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall make a long column-visibility list scrollable independently of the table so that every column can be reached.

title: Row actions are missing when using multiple REPLACE
reason: Row actions disappear for a SELECT whose select list contains several REPLACE calls because the legacy parser misjudges the query and hides editable rows.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show row actions for any single-table SELECT that returns the table primary key, regardless of expressions in the select list.

title: Query and result is no longer visible after row Copy
reason: After a row copy the executed query and its result disappear from the page, a visible 6.0-dev regression of the insert-after-copy flow.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the submitted statement and its result or status message visible after a copied row is inserted.

title: Missing pagination on views
reason: Views are browsed through the same default SELECT with LIMIT paging, so the missing pagination on views is covered by the generic pagination rule.

title: CodeMirror is missing when editing a view
reason: The CodeMirror editor is missing when editing a view.

title: Feature: Use Select2 with search field in "create relation to foreign key" to select foreign key table
reason: The foreign-key table dropdown in create relation has no search, which is hard to use with hundreds of tables.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide a searchable table selector in the create-relation form.

title: LegacyAdmin wrong icon import/export in bootstrap theme
reason: Wrong icon for export and import in the bootstrap theme, a theme chore.

title: Impossible to unselect SET value
reason: A SET column cannot be returned to the empty set once a member is selected.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall allow a SET column to be saved as the empty set and shall offer a way to clear all selected members.

title: Creating Relations: Automatic pre-selection based on normalization
reason: The create-relation form could pre-select the referenced table and its primary key once a table is chosen.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall pre-select the primary key of the referenced table in the create-relation form when the user chooses that table.

title: slow listing of tables compared to legacyadmin 4.9.7
reason: Table listing is reported slower than in 4.9.x on cPanel, with no concrete cause in the body.

title: The LegacyAdmin demo version doesn't work
reason: Demo site and local install not working, a support question.

title: Add repository for Ubuntu 23.04
reason: Packaging repository request for an Ubuntu release.

title: WriteGitRevisionCommand.php should be removed
reason: Developer request to remove a git-revision PHP command.

title: GIS visualization not working on MariaDB
reason: GIS visualization white screen on MariaDB 10.4, below the DBLoom minimum of 10.11.

title: Maximum execution time of 120 seconds exceeded in ErrorHandler class
reason: Local XAMPP PHP max execution time error, a support question.

title: An invalid authentication method shows dashboard instead of login page
reason: An invalid auth_type shows the dashboard instead of the login page.

title: Uncaught TypeError: can't access property 0, neighbor.data is undefined
reason: The chart tooltip throws an uncaught TypeError when hovering a point whose series data is missing.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not raise uncaught errors when a chart tooltip is shown for a point whose series data is missing.

title: LegacyAdmin Does Not Display when Hotlink Protection is Enabled (net::ERR_ABORTED 403)
reason: Hotlink protection with blank referrers blocks the page, a legacy PHP hosting configuration issue.

title: When upgradng and using php-fpm, restarting php-fpm is required
reason: php-fpm needs a restart after an upgrade, a PHP deployment issue.

title: Central column with a default value cannot be created or edited
reason: A central column with a default value cannot be created or edited.

title: PHP Fatal error:  Allowed memory size of 134217728 bytes exhausted (tried to allocate 26212192 bytes) in /libraries/classes/Session.php on line 204
reason: Out-of-memory error in PHP session handling after a large CSV import, a PHP session-engine issue.

title: config.sample.inc.php refer to FAQ 2.10 which doesn't exist
reason: A PHP config sample refers to a nonexistent FAQ entry, a documentation chore.

title: Please bring back the link to the table groups
reason: Duplicate report of the missing table group link.

title: problem in Build trigger legacyadmin near DECLARE
reason: Syntax error near DECLARE in a user trigger, a user SQL question that is usually a missing DELIMITER.

title: Please improve documentation of "Export to SQL" command
reason: Documentation request for SQL export options.

title: Should file /js/messages.php be visible on the web?
reason: Question whether the PHP helper script js/messages.php should be web-visible, a PHP-specific question.

title: UI bug with bootstrap theme on settings > Page related settings
reason: List bullets on a settings page under the bootstrap theme, a theme CSS chore.

title: Several issues with multiple servers and SSO (signon) plugin
reason: Several issues with multiple servers under signon authentication are reported, but the body does not list them.

title: Exported filename does not use renamed aliases
reason: Export filename placeholders use the original names instead of the renamed aliases.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall resolve the @DATABASE@ and @TABLE@ filename placeholders to the alias name when an alias is set for the export.

title: View export missing when contain union statement
reason: Exported view SQL lacks a space before UNION, which makes the statement invalid on re-import.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export view definitions as statements that re-import without error, including views whose definition contains UNION.

title: ENUM Set - Cannot Edit Values
reason: The ENUM value list does not appear in the edit view, so new enum values cannot be added, but the body gives no cause.

title: Wrong Autosuggestion when Column Name ends with a Dot (.)
reason: Autocomplete inserts a broken identifier when a column name ends with a dot.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall quote table and column names inserted by autocomplete with backticks, doubling embedded backticks and keeping every character of the name, including a trailing dot.

title: replicate-ignore-table - table is still showing as being replicated
reason: Replication status lists a table excluded by replicate-ignore-table as still replicated, but the body does not show whether the display or the server is at fault.

title: My database was deleted without my request
reason: Support request to recover a local database lost after a PC restart.

title: Better documentation on "colorModes" directive
reason: Documentation request for the colorModes theme directive.

title: Uncaught TypeError: window.Chart is not a constructor
reason: Profiling chart fails because the Chart library is not yet defined, a legacy JavaScript loading order issue.

title: Importing indexation produces userunfriendly error messages
reason: The import timeout report is a template and does not name the failing index or auto-increment step.

title: LegacyAdmin extremely slow on view. Ability to disable row editing on view to speed up display
reason: Browsing a view is very slow although its query runs fast, because row-editing checks run for the view.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall determine whether a view is updatable once per view rather than per row, and shall let the user turn off row editing for views.

title: Search doesn't work with `IN (...)`, `NOT IN (...)` operators on `INT` column types with no foreign key
reason: IN, NOT IN, BETWEEN and NOT BETWEEN searches fail on INT columns without a foreign key.

title: Improve multiple triggers export/drop
reason: Exporting or dropping many triggers sends one request per trigger, which is very slow for large sets.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export or drop several selected triggers in a single request.

title: Uncaught TypeError: can't access property 0, chartData[key][j] is undefined
reason: The system monitor page throws an uncaught TypeError when a chart series has missing data.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render the available chart series and show a gap for missing values instead of failing with an uncaught script error.

title: Display chart is not working on big tables
reason: Display chart exhausts memory on large tables because the whole table is loaded to draw the chart.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall compute chart data on the server in bounded memory, using aggregation or sampling, and shall not load the whole table into memory to draw a chart.

title: Show this query here again checkbox configuration
reason: The show-this-query-here-again checkbox cannot be set as default, unlike the retain-query-box option.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let each user set the default state of the show-this-query-here-again option in preferences.

title: ValueError: max(): Argument #1 ($value) must contain at least one element
reason: PDF export fails with a PHP max() error inside the TCPDF library.

title: PDF export - ErrorException: Undefined array key
reason: PDF export fails inside the TCPDF library font code, a PHP library defect.

title: mysql_native_password authentication plugin is deprecated in MySQL 8.1
reason: mysql_native_password is deprecated and disabled by default on MySQL 8.4, yet the app may still offer it when creating or changing accounts.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not create or change an account to mysql_native_password unless the user explicitly selects it and the target server allows it, and shall show a deprecation warning when it is selected.

title: Failed to load login after clean install via PPA
reason: Login fails after a clean install from the Ubuntu PPA package, a packaging issue.

title: Uploading clock stop at 70%
reason: The upload progress clock stops at 70 percent, so the displayed progress is unreliable.

title: Investigate if CloudFront and CloudFlare client IPs are correctly logged
reason: Client IP behind CloudFront or Cloudflare is not read from the forwarded header, so access logs record the proxy address.

title: Check "Retain query box" by default
reason: The retain-query-box option is unchecked by default, so users must tick it on every visit.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall default the retain-query-box option to enabled and let each user change it in preferences.

title: v. 5.2.1 displays errors messages as user accounts
reason: The user accounts list fills with error-message rows that hide the real accounts.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show errors from the user account query in a separate message area and shall never render them as rows of the account list.

title: Cookie "pma_theme_color_https" does not have a proper "SameSite" attribute value.
reason: Theme cookie lacks a proper SameSite attribute value.

title: Scrollbar is missing if profiling was previously enabled
reason: Profiling output in the simulate-query result has no scrollbar, so long profiles cannot be read.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall make the profiling and simulation result area scrollable whenever its content exceeds the visible area.

title: Row edit has now() preselected on timestamp columns
reason: Row edit form preselects now() for timestamp columns so saving an unchanged row overwrites stored timestamps.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not preselect a function default such as CURRENT_TIMESTAMP in the edit form of an existing row, so that saving a row without user changes leaves all stored values unchanged.

title: Missing digits from User accounts overview
reason: Digits without users are hidden in the user accounts initials list instead of shown as disabled.

title: Import data is stored in session
reason: Importing a file stores its contents in the PHP session, which inflates session storage and slows Redis.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not store import file contents in the session and shall keep only import progress metadata there.

title: Duplicate `token` when copying rows
reason: Duplicate token parameter in legacy URL building for row copy; DBLoom does not use URL tokens.

title: Rename ['verbose'] to ['alias']
reason: Renaming a legacy PHP config key from verbose to alias.

title: Unable to work with foreign keys when partial unique index exist.
reason: Foreign keys cannot be edited on tables that have a partial or functional unique index.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall list and edit foreign keys on tables that contain functional or partial indexes without failing.

title: LegacyAdmin5.2.1 functions slowly (>10s per action)
reason: Slow-operation report with no reproduction and a legacy configuration.

title: Slow browse page load with multi-column foreign key
reason: Browse makes one request per column and row to build multi-column foreign-key tooltips, which is very slow.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall load foreign-key link previews for a page in one batched query per foreign key, using all columns of a composite key.

title: session_start(): Failed to decode session object. Session has been destroyed
reason: PHP session decode error in legacy session handling.

title: We are unable to scale out legacyadmin for multi instance session
reason: PHP session save_path permission mismatch with remote session storage.

title: Reconsider use of X-XSS-Protection
reason: X-XSS-Protection header is obsolete and should not be sent.

title: Can't log in with cookie auth on Wordpress Azure App Service when you have multiple instances
reason: Cookie authentication fails across several app instances behind a load balancer.

title: Integrate explainmysql.com to Help With Understanding EXPLAIN Output
reason: User wants help explaining EXPLAIN output, via an external explainmysql.com link.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall provide in-app explanations of each EXPLAIN column and warning without sending query text to an external site.

title: What is the use of $cfg['Servers'][$i]['compress']?
reason: Documentation question about the legacy compress server option.

title: LegacyAdmin login page - Language: German - username and colon behind not in the same line.
reason: German login label wraps so the colon falls onto the next line.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall lay out login labels so that the longest translation and its colon stay on one line at the minimum supported width.

title: Space usage information seems wrong
reason: Effective size of a table shows a negative value after mass delete, displayed in bytes.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall never display negative size values and shall label information_schema size figures as estimates.

title: Changing privileges deletes the user password
reason: Editing privileges of an existing account clears its password.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall never change an account's authentication credential when the user edits only privileges.

title: Adding privileges to DB does not work because of "_"
reason: Reported as invalid; MySQL requires the underscore to be escaped in database-level GRANT patterns, so the escaped form is correct.

title: Wrong row total for LegacyAdmin 5.2.1 with query including "LEFT JOIN" and "LIKE"
reason: Total row count for a query with LEFT JOIN and LIKE is taken from the first table, so paging is wrong.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall compute the total row count of a user query from the complete query, not from one table of a join.

title: Wrong syntax for mysql 8.0 issued creating replication user on mysql 5.7 system
reason: Creating a replication user emits MySQL 8 syntax (REQUIRE SSL WITH ...) that a 5.7 master rejects; privilege SQL must be version-aware.

title: Query Result, Edit Inline not working
reason: Stale support report that the Edit inline button does nothing, on a legacy 6.0-dev build with no reproduction.

title: left over files in the release packages
reason: Release packages include composer and lock files, a PHP packaging issue.

title: Abrir um arquivo pdf/docx/word salvo em um blob
reason: A BLOB file (PDF, DOCX) downloads as .bin and cannot be opened in its original form.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer downloading a BLOB cell with a file name and content type detected from its leading bytes.

title: NavigationTreeTableSeparator directive is not working properly
reason: NavigationTreeTableSeparator grouping does not work as documented.

title: `text-nowrap` for timestamps columns
reason: Timestamp columns in the structure list wrap onto several lines on small screens.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep date and time values in listings on one line.

title: Columns header transparent when scrolling
reason: Column header cells of the query result grid have a transparent background while scrolling.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall give sticky result-grid headers an opaque background in every theme.

title: Popup error after idle time
reason: Error popup after idle time linked to clearSession.php, with no reproduction steps and not enough detail to decide.

title: search for table name does not search in all tables unless you hit enter
reason: Tree search filters only the loaded page and needs Enter; DBLoom tree filters run as server-side LIKE queries with live filtering.

title: CSP nonce
reason: Support question about adding a CSP nonce to legacy LegacyAdmin scripts.

title: div not completely visible when adding a new table
reason: Clipped new-table form in the legacy pmahomme and original themes.

title: Wierd text
reason: Body is only an image with no description, so the intent cannot be determined.

title: Importing SQL compatibility mode MSSQL not working
reason: Legacy SQL compatibility-mode option for MSSQL import; a server-side mode that is not a DBLoom requirement.

title: Two scroll bars when routines, events, triggers are exported
reason: Double scrollbar in the legacy export modal for routines, caused by jQuery modal CSS.

title: GIS Visualization issue - Uncaught TypeError: can't access property "getUnits", sourceProj is null
reason: GIS visualisation throws an error when a geometry has an SRID other than 0 or 4326.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render GIS values with any valid SRID or show a clear unsupported-SRID message without throwing an error.

title: LegacyAdmin SSL Cipher Support
reason: Legacy client cannot negotiate strong TLS cipher suites with the database server.

title: #1231 - Variable 'character_set_client' can't be set to the value of 'NULL'
reason: Resumed chunked import loses the charset header, so later chunks fail with a character_set_client NULL error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the charset and session settings in every chunk of a resumed import.

title: `$cfg['NaturalOrder']` is ignored in Create new trigger modal
reason: Trigger editor ignores the natural-order setting that the rest of the UI uses for object lists.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply one sort-order rule to every object picker, including trigger, routine and event editors.

title: Browse foreign values should show correct uuid keys
reason: Foreign-value picker shows raw bytes for binary(16) key columns instead of readable keys.
