proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall display binary key values in foreign-value pickers in the same hex or UUID form used by browse and shall insert the selected key unchanged.

title: Function/Procedure editor NOT supporting ROW data type in parameter list for MariaDB
reason: Routine editor rejects ROW-typed parameters and cannot save routines whose parameter types it does not recognise.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall preserve routine parameter types it does not recognise and shall save a routine unchanged apart from the fields the user edited.

title: Mouse pointer not accurate when hovering or clicking icons in sidebar
reason: Sidebar icon hit areas are offset, so a click opens a different database than the one under the pointer.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall make the clickable area of every tree icon match its rendered position so the item clicked is the item under the pointer.

title: 6.0: Table tree re-opens/animates everytime + forgets position when changing inner tab
reason: Table tree re-animates and loses pagination position when switching inner tabs in 6.0.

title: Error 404 during drop column when the PmaAbsoluteUri is not set
reason: HTTP 404 on column drop caused by the PHP PmaAbsoluteUri URL setting.

title: Export/Import with a column being a binary(16) doesn't work correctly
reason: Export and import of binary(16) columns corrupts the data in CSV and creates a wrongly named table on import.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export binary columns in a lossless encoding (hex or base64) in all text formats and shall import them back unchanged.

title: In version 5.2.1 the individual user needs permission to access the legacyadmin.pma tables.
reason: Legacy access to la_ configuration tables for SELECT-only users; DBLoom keeps its own store, so this table privilege model does not apply.

title: Clearing up the 2FA confusion
reason: Discussion of outdated PHP composer libraries for 2FA (google2fa-qrcode).

title: Console tab is taking focus
reason: A delayed console panel takes keyboard focus away from a field the user is typing in.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not move keyboard focus away from an input the user is editing when a background panel finishes loading.

title: [6.0-dev] Tree is collapsing constantly
reason: Navigation tree collapses and reloads when switching databases in 6.0-dev, losing open nodes.

title: Internal error: TypeError: ini_set() expects parameter 2 to be string, int given TypeError: ini_set() expects parameter 2 to be string, int given
reason: PHP ini_set TypeError in the legacy console, a PHP 8 type error.

title: Horizontal scrollbar on Browse tab should only apply to table content
reason: A wide browse table makes the whole page scroll horizontally instead of only the table content.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall confine horizontal scrolling of wide result tables to the table container so the page chrome stays fixed.

title: Optional key relationships to speed up listing
reason: User wants foreign-key target values in the browse listing as an optional setting, since they slow listing on slow connections.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a per-user option to show foreign-key target values in the browse listing, loaded after the main rows so the listing renders first.

title: Searching in tables should use UTF8MB4, not just utf8, to avoid warnings
reason: Search queries use the utf8 alias for CONVERT, so MySQL warning 3719 appears on every browse of search results.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall build search and comparison queries with utf8mb4 and shall not produce the utf8mb3 alias warning.

title: Status variables documentation links to dev.mysql.com are invalid
reason: Status variable help links point to a generic manual page instead of the variable's own documentation anchor.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall link each status variable to its own documentation anchor and not to a generic manual page.

title: Language combobox is hard to read
reason: The language selector sorts by English name, which makes native-script names hard to find.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall list languages in the selector by their native name, with the English name shown alongside.

title: Failed to store CSRF Token in Session! Probably Sessions are not working properly
reason: IIS and PHP session installation problem.

title: A 64-char hex string should be allowed for the blowfish_secret config directive
reason: A 32-byte blowfish secret encoded as 64 hex characters is already the stored and generated format.

title: Maybe a bug?
reason: The report describes a popup that disappeared, with no reproduction steps or cause.

title: Create PHP code creates broken code and encourages SQL injection
reason: The Create PHP code button generates PHP source; DBLoom produces no PHP output.

title: Columns List Missing in Left Navigation
reason: The navigation tree children of a table, including its columns, are specified.

title: Duplicate ids on same page
reason: The page emits duplicate HTML id attributes, which breaks scripts and accessibility.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall emit each HTML id attribute at most once per rendered page.

title: failed to connect to recaptcha service
reason: reCAPTCHA verification and its failure paths are already specified, although the request-method and hostname detail is not stated separately.

title: Ability to disable SQL editor toolbar buttons
reason: Users want to hide the SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE template buttons in the SQL editor toolbar.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let an administrator hide the statement-template buttons of the SQL editor toolbar.

title: Export/Import database problem
reason: Exporting views and routines rewrites their SQL, adding ASC or DESC and duplicated grouping, so the export no longer matches the stored definition.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export view, routine and event definitions exactly as the server returns them, without rewriting their SQL text.

title: Server connection: SSL is not being used
reason: Support question about PHP SSL configuration in Docker.

title: Column sorting does not work when names contain dots
reason: Clicking a column header does not sort when the column name contains dots, because the sort clause is built from a text fragment.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall quote every column identifier in sort and browse SQL in full, including names with dots, spaces or backticks.

title: Add config parameter: Enable/Disable backtick quoting
reason: Users want to copy SQL without backtick identifier quoting, while quoting should stay the default.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep identifier quoting in all generated SQL and shall offer a copy action without identifier quoting only when the user chooses it.

title: Drop comma from input (number of columns)
reason: The screenshot-only report of a comma in the number-of-columns field cannot be understood from the title and body.

title: ErrorException: foreach() argument must be of type array|object, string given
reason: Error-report dialog crash inside the PHP error report class.

title: Error in a function IN(...) and NOT IN(....) for query
reason: The IN and NOT IN query fails, but the title and body give no SQL or error message.

title: better hint / autocompletion for INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, GROUP BY
reason: SQL autocomplete suggests single keywords only, not common multi-word forms such as INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN and GROUP BY.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer multi-word SQL completions such as INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN and GROUP BY when the typed prefix matches their first word.

title: [Idea] Malware Scanner
reason: Scanning stored data for malware is outside the scope of a database administration tool and has no concrete defect.

title: Javascript Error: createPopper is not a function
reason: Popper JavaScript packaging error in LegacyAdmin's bundled assets.

title: SLAVE MONITOR Privilege missing / lost when saving User
reason: Saving a user's privileges silently removes the SLAVE MONITOR privilege because the privilege form does not carry privileges it does not display.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall preserve every global privilege of a user that the privilege form does not display when saving that user's privileges.

title: Bind Parameters - support `?`
reason: The bind-parameter feature supports only named placeholders, so positional ? placeholders from error logs are not detected.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall detect positional ? placeholders as well as named placeholders in the SQL editor and offer a single field to enter all parameter values in order.

title: Error when viewing new Vector datatype introduced in MySQL 9.0
reason: Viewing MySQL 9 VECTOR columns is already covered by the proposed DBLoom requirements for VECTOR types.

title: Uncaught Error: cannot call methods on draggable prior to initialization; attempted to call method 'destroy'
reason: The GIS editor throws an uncaught draggable error when a second polygon editor is opened after the base-layer setting was changed.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall initialise each geometry editor instance once and shall not raise an error when a second editor is opened.

title: Copying A DB To NewDB Then Drop NewDB, Then Copying DB To NewDB Again Results In Error.
reason: Copying a database to a name that was dropped earlier fails with a duplicate-key error on mysql.db because stale privilege rows remain.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report leftover privilege rows for a database name before copying into that name, instead of failing with a duplicate-key error.

title: Misleading query results on query fail
reason: After a failed query, the previous table browse results remain on screen, so the user sees misleading data.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall clear previous result rows when a query fails and show only the error for the failed statement.

title: TypeError: implode(): Argument #1 ($pieces) must be of type array, string given
reason: Creating a procedure with an OUT parameter shows a PHP TypeError and a misleading error even though the routine may have been created.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report the result of CREATE PROCEDURE and CREATE FUNCTION accurately and shall not show a failure message for a routine that was created.

title: Login screen could remember the server selected last time
reason: The login page does not remember the server chosen at the previous login.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall preselect on the login page the server used at the last successful login when that choice is stored for the user.

title: ERRO Symfony/Component/ExpressionLanguage/autoload.php
reason: Packaging of a Symfony PHP dependency on Ubuntu.

title: Support of Cluster  MySQL connections (Read & Write Ports)
reason: Users want separate read and write endpoints so that read queries can go to replicas while writes go to the primary.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall allow a server connection to define a separate read endpoint, used only for read queries, while writes always go to the primary endpoint.

title: LegacyAdmin very slow with RDS (MariaDB 10.11) on another region
reason: The title and body do not show whether the slowness comes from network latency or from the number of round trips per page.

title: Declaration is not compatible
reason: PHP method-signature packaging error.

title: Single quotes around unix_timestamp(current_timestamp(6))
reason: A default expression such as unix_timestamp(current_timestamp(6)) on a double column is quoted as a string on insert, because the unquoted rule covers only date and time columns.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall insert a column's default SQL expression unquoted for any column type when the user keeps the default.

title: Provide config option to autofocus Username field on login page
reason: Users want the login username field focused on page load, behind a setting because autofocus can hurt accessibility.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a setting that focuses the username field on the login page, off by default.

title: Blank page when import a large CSV file
reason: Large CSV import is covered by bounded-memory chunked reading and import time-out handling; the PHP parser time-out is a legacy implementation detail.

title: ErrorException: Attempt to read property "keyword" on null
reason: Labelled as a duplicate, and the crash is inside the PHP sql-parser library.

title: Display database comments next to database names in sidebar list (tree)
reason: Database comments are visible only in the breadcrumb and not next to database names in the navigation tree.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show a database's comment next to its name in the navigation tree when a comment is set.

title: \r\n is replaced with \n when clicking on a value
reason: Opening a long text value for inline editing or copying turns stored CR LF sequences into LF, so the value changes on round trip.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall preserve the exact characters of stored text values, including CR LF sequences and values longer than 1024 characters, when they are shown for editing or copying.

title: Option to skip first line when importing a CSV file into existing table is missing
reason: Importing a CSV into an existing table offers no option stating that the first line holds column names, and the skip option is labelled for SQL only.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer, for CSV import into an existing table, an option stating whether the first line contains column names, and shall label skip options by the formats they apply to.

title: After the second line of the INSERT contains a non-null nullable ENUM value, the third line automatically assigns an illegal non-null ENUM value
reason: In a multi-row insert form, a value set on one row is carried into the following row, which then receives an illegal ENUM value.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall submit for each row of a multi-row insert only the values entered for that row.

title: Searching on a VARBINARY field
reason: A VARBINARY value displayed as 0x hex is searched as a quoted string, so copying the hex back into a table search does not match the bytes.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall treat a 0x-prefixed hexadecimal value entered for a binary column in table search as a hexadecimal literal.

title: Improve mime types when exporting as CSV and JSON
reason: CSV exports are served with the non-standard media type text/comma-separated-values instead of text/csv, and the JSON fix is tracked separately as still open.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall serve CSV exports with the media type text/csv and JSON exports with the media type application/json.

title: More options for export function
reason: Users want an export option that writes all table structures and indexes before the data, so a failed import can be located quickly.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer an SQL export option that writes all CREATE TABLE statements, including indexes and AUTO_INCREMENT values, before any INSERT statements.

title: misleading statement  "Skip current error/Skip next _ errors" , in   Replication - Replica replication -   Error management
reason: The replica error-management labels describe the legacy binlog-event skip counter as skip-error handling, which SEC-SRV-012 already records as a weakness.

title: Import CSV shows success and failure as a result
reason: CSV import reports success even when column names are rejected or exceed the identifier length limit, or a wrong delimiter merges all names into one column.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report a CSV import as failed, not successful, when any column name is rejected by the server or exceeds the MySQL or MariaDB identifier length limit.

title: UrlRedirector doesn't work when an extension is missing
reason: URL redirection failure when a PHP extension is missing is specific to the PHP runtime.

title: Feature Request: 6.0 Bootstrap Auto Mode and Default it
reason: Users want the default theme to follow the device light or dark preference, and FR-CFG-017 only reconciles stored theme cookies and preferences.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer an automatic theme mode that follows the operating system light or dark preference and use it as the default for new users.

title: Add Support for Trigger Execution Order in MariaDB
reason: Multiple triggers of the same type can have an explicit execution order on MariaDB, and the SPEC offers no way to view or set it.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let users view and set the execution order of multiple triggers of the same type on MariaDB.

title: [6.0] LegacyAdmin\Exceptions\MissingTheme
reason: Blank-page PHP exception for a missing custom theme; DBLoom does not load PHP themes.

title: POINT Columns Cause Missing PRIMARY KEY and AUTO_INCREMENT Attributes in LegacyAdmin Exports
reason: SQL export drops PRIMARY KEY and AUTO_INCREMENT from the id column when the table also has a spatial column, so the dump cannot be re-imported.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall emit PRIMARY KEY and AUTO_INCREMENT definitions in SQL exports for every table, regardless of spatial or other column types.

title: Invalid Semantic Versioning for Snapshots
reason: A SemVer-invalid version string affects npm tooling, not DBLoom behaviour.

title: 6.0 - Navbar is missing its full width gradient
reason: Missing navbar gradient in a PHP theme is a cosmetic theme chore.

title: 6.0 - The code font size is smaller compared to 5.2
reason: SQL text in code blocks is smaller than before and lost its padding in the new theme.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render SQL text in code blocks at a minimum readable font size of 12 px with consistent padding in every theme.

title: Allow prepopulating username from GET parameter for bookmarks/links
reason: The login form cannot be pre-filled with a username from a link, so bookmarks cannot select an account.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall accept an optional username parameter that pre-fills the login form and shall never accept a password in the URL.

title: MySQL 8.0.30: GIPK Mode insert errors
reason: The insert form emits an undefined-key warning for a table with an invisible generated primary key.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall hide invisible or generated columns from insert and edit forms without warnings and without requiring a value for them.

title: Execute option is disabled but user has the EXECUTE privilege
reason: The Execute action is hidden for a user who holds EXECUTE on the routine, although the server allows the call.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer routine execution to every user whose grants allow EXECUTE on that routine and shall not hide the action based on a narrower check.

title: Strange dots on the characters in the table cells.
reason: Question about what a theme CSS rule does, which is a support question about the PHP theme.

title: Documentation has different themes
reason: Documentation site themes differ between languages, which is a documentation infrastructure chore.

title: Move default search operator for varchar columns into configurable options
reason: The default search operator for string columns is a leading-wildcard LIKE that cannot use indexes and is slow on large tables.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user or administrator choose the default operator for string search, including an index-friendly prefix match.

title: use CDN to provide static files
reason: Operators want static assets to be cacheable at a CDN in front of a self-hosted origin to reduce origin load.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall serve static assets with versioned file names and long-lived cache headers so that reverse proxies and CDNs can cache them without contacting the origin.

title: Outdated info and broken Links in bundled docs
reason: Broken links and outdated text in the bundled PHP-era documentation that DBLoom does not ship.

title: import sql file
reason: The Import button remains active while a long import is still running, so a second import can be started.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall disable the import submit control while an import is in progress and shall show the progress state.

title: New Event form's Go button missing
reason: Changing the event type in the New Event form replaces the Go button with a dropdown, so the form cannot be submitted.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the submit control visible and enabled in the event form for every selectable event type.

title: Modals become inaccessible when changing the browser window size
reason: Modal dialogs keep their size and position when the window is resized, so their lower and right parts become unreachable.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep every dialog fully reachable when the browser window is resized, including while a dialog is open.

title: After creating an event/procedure shown query is missing `DELIMITER $$` to be executable again
reason: The DDL shown after creating a procedure or event omits the DELIMITER lines, so it cannot be re-executed as displayed.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show routine and event DDL that re-executes unchanged in a plain client, including the delimiter lines needed for bodies containing semicolons.

title: Procedure/Trigger/Event gets deleted when an error occurs when changing it
reason: Changing a procedure owned by another user drops it and then fails to recreate it, which is the data-loss case of the routine multi-update transactionality requirement.

title: Installing legacyadmin on ubuntu server gives error 28000 with root user even if its properly configured the root user.
reason: Debian installer root-password prompt is a packaging issue of the PHP release, not DBLoom behaviour.

title: more that one column
reason: Spelling error in bundled documentation text.

title: Unmet dependencies when installing LegacyAdmin using ppa:legacyadmin/ppa
reason: PPA packaging dependency problem on Ubuntu is a PHP distribution packaging issue.

title: LoginCookieRecall = false is not working
reason: Duplicate of an existing report about LoginCookieRecall.

title: Numbers format
reason: Numeric input fields reject digit-group separators such as spaces or underscores.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall accept digit-group separators (space or underscore) in numeric input fields when the value remains unambiguous.

title: blank white page issue in version 4.9.11 with php 7.4 on ubuntu 24.04.02 LTS
reason: Blank page on PHP 7.4 with LegacyAdmin 4.9.11 is a support question for an obsolete PHP-based release.

title: Existing values are no longer filled in automatically when editing rows.
reason: Since 5.2.2 the row edit form opens with empty fields instead of the stored values of the selected row.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall pre-fill the row edit form with the stored values of the selected row.

title: does not set a GRANT at the database level for a database user
reason: Database-level privileges granted through the UI are shown as not granted, because the generated REVOKE and GRANT sequence differs from a manual GRANT.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall grant database-level privileges with a statement the server accepts for a manual GRANT and shall show the grant state read back from the server.

title: Status/Processes: allow URL to specify "show only active" and sort by time desc
reason: Process list filters (active only) and the sort order are sent as POST data, so the view cannot be bookmarked or shared as a URL.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall encode process-list filters and sort order in the URL so that the view can be bookmarked and shared.

title: It no longer goes to page 1 after sorting
reason: After sorting a column while on a later page, the result stays on that page instead of returning to page 1.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall return the result position to the first page whenever the sort order changes.

title: Support Invisible Indexes
reason: Support for invisible indexes is already proposed as a DBLoom target feature.

title: Search, then Refresh -> loses search clauses
reason: Clicking Refresh after a search drops the search criteria and shows the default full table view.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the active search criteria when a result page is refreshed.

title: Show warning when users can directly manipulate mysql database without CREATE USER privilege
reason: Administrators cannot see that an account with global INSERT or UPDATE on the mysql schema can change users without holding CREATE USER.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall warn on the privileges page when an account holds global INSERT or UPDATE privileges but not CREATE USER.

title: Incorrect default value when changing/altering a column if the default value of the column is an empty string
reason: The column edit form shows NULL instead of an empty-string default, so saving the form changes the default.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall distinguish an empty-string default from NULL or no default in the column edit form and shall preserve it on save.

title: Random millisecond value wen editing time in the webinterface
reason: Editing a TIME value with fractional seconds replaces the fractional part with a random value.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the fractional-second precision of TIME, DATETIME and TIMESTAMP values unchanged unless the user edits them.

title: Inconsistent Display of `BIT(n)` Values in "Browse" View in Decimal and Binary Formats
reason: BIT(n) values are shown in decimal in browse but must be typed in binary, and they stay in binary after a save.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall use one documented display and input format for BIT(n) values in browse, edit and after save.

title: Fail to copy database when it includes descending Indexes
reason: Copying a database that contains descending indexes fails.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall preserve the sort direction (DESC) of index columns when copying a table or a database.

title: #1025 - Error on rename of '.\mydb/#sql-1b60_c5e' in '.\mydb\mytable' (Error: 150 "Foreign key constraint is incorrectly formed")
reason: Error 150 persists after the foreign key was dropped, but the body is only a screenshot link and the cause (legacy table rebuild or FK state) is not clear.

title: Datetime default value error
reason: The body is only a screenshot link, so the datetime default error on removing the last column cannot be reproduced from the text.

title: Wrong "Duplicate column name" error
reason: The body is only a screenshot link, so the trigger of the "Duplicate column name" error cannot be determined.

title: Wrong "Wrong default value" error
reason: A datetime(3) default of '1000-01-01 00:00:00' is rejected with a "Wrong default value" error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall validate column default values with the server's own rules and accept every default that the server accepts, including the minimum DATETIME value.

title: View bug: The latest records are not visible when navigating through pages
reason: Browsing a table without a deterministic ORDER BY returns inconsistent rows across pages, so the latest rows appear missing.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall browse tables with a deterministic ORDER BY (the primary key by default) so that every row appears on exactly one page.

title: Fatal error: Allowed memory size of 536870912 bytes exhausted (tried to allocate 38748392 bytes) in `libraries/classes/Url.php` on line 292
reason: A 20 MB CSV import exhausted PHP memory, and memory-bounded import reading is already specified.

title: Support fuzzy matching table names
reason: Table name autocomplete only matches prefixes, so users must type long prefixes when many tables share a name stem.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall match SQL autocomplete suggestions for table and column names by subsequence (fuzzy) matching and rank prefix matches first.

title: [Bug]: SQL Parser Error with CASE Statement and column Alias
reason: The legacy SQL parser rejects a valid CASE expression with a table alias, which blocks the query.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not reject syntactically valid MySQL or MariaDB statements in its own pre-checks and shall pass them to the server, showing the server error if it fails.

title: [Bug]:  browse column comment charset wrong while comments on structure view are OK
reason: The browse view shows table comments in a wrong character set while the structure view shows them correctly.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall decode and display table comments in the same character set in every view that shows them.

title: [Bug]: legacyadmin 6.0 not working on PHP 8.4.5/Windows - sodium not installed
reason: Missing PHP sodium extension on PHP 8.4 is a PHP runtime requirement that DBLoom does not share.

title: [Bug]: Redirect route bug
reason: A malformed route that repeats a path segment is a redirect loop, and the wave-1 routing rules already require deterministic 404 handling for unknown routes.

title: [Bug]: legacyadmin 5.2.1 "Advisor" incorrectly reports RDBMS Engine running 32-bit binaries
reason: The Advisor reports a 32-bit server when version_compile_machine is empty, which is a false warning.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report the server architecture as unknown rather than 32-bit when the version_compile_* variables are empty.

title: [Bug]: Spacial data reverts x and y whenever edited
reason: Editing a POINT with an SRID swaps x and y, so an unchanged geometry is written back as a different value.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall write geometry values back in their original axis order and shall not mark a geometry cell as changed unless the user edited it.

title: [Bug]: Warning in ./libraries/classes/DatabaseInterface.php#815 - Undefined array key 1
reason: Renaming a column alias in the Edit View form produces a PHP warning and a broken edit flow.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall parse view definitions including column aliases and shall keep the view editor usable when an alias is changed.

title: [Bug]: Export incomplete view
reason: A custom export silently produced an incomplete view definition that only failed on import.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall fail the export with a visible error instead of writing a truncated or incomplete view definition.

title: [Bug]: binary(16) DEFAULT value is incorrectly exported
reason: SQL export writes a binary(16) DEFAULT value as a bare token that does not re-import.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export binary column default values as valid hexadecimal literals (x'...' or 0x...) that re-import unchanged.

title: [Bug]: Exporting views with union does not put a space before the keyword union
reason: Exporting a view can glue the UNION keyword to the preceding token, so the exported view DDL is invalid SQL.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export view definitions verbatim from SHOW CREATE VIEW and shall not rewrite view SQL token by token in a way that can merge keywords.

title: [Feat]: Fetch console history only when required (switched to history tab)
reason: Query history loads on every page load, slowing pages with long histories, and users want it loaded only when the history tab opens.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall load the query history only when its panel is opened and shall fetch it in pages.

title: [Bug]: running legacyadmin version 5.2.2 for php 7.4 stop working and show new requirement!
reason: The request concerns PHP 7.4 version requirements, which do not apply to the MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 10.11 baseline of DBLoom.

title: [Bug]: duplicate whitespace not displayed
reason: Multiple spaces in SQL text and results collapse in the browser, so queries that differ only in spacing look identical.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall preserve whitespace in SQL text and in displayed query results.

title: [Feat]: Setting to output all SQL to include the database name
reason: Users want a setting that qualifies all generated SQL with the database name.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a setting that qualifies table names with their database name in all SQL it generates and displays.

title: [Bug]: Visual Query Builder incorrect SQL syntax
reason: The visual query builder emits the same join twice and joins the wrong tables in a three-table query, causing error 1066.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall generate each table reference once and join each table only on its declared foreign-key or user-chosen columns.

title: [Feat]: Simbiat Libraries Integration
reason: Schema tools are requested: dependency-ordered table lists, warnings for cyclic foreign keys, and foreign-key violation checks.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall order tables by foreign-key dependency for export and shall warn about cyclic foreign-key chains.

title: [Feat]: visualize changes on refresh
reason: Users want changed cells highlighted after a refresh of a SELECT result, with the previous value shown.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a refresh mode for SELECT results that highlights cells whose value changed since the previous run and shows the previous value.

title: [Bug]: Encoding conversion is not working when exporting in CSV format
reason: CSV export ignores the selected output charset, so Shift_JIS output is written as UTF-8.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall write export output in the charset the user selects, including Shift_JIS for CSV.

title: [Bug]: "Simulate Query" in LegacyAdmin 5.2.1 Incorrectly Reports No Rows Affected
reason: Simulate query reports zero matched rows for an UPDATE whose WHERE clause uses IS NULL, and the SPEC does not specify this simulation (04 coverage note lists SimulateDml only).
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report the matched row count of a simulated DML statement by applying the statement own WHERE clause, including IS NULL conditions.

title: [Bug]: Cannot insert or edit Point type columns with LegacyAdmin UI
reason: Editing a POINT column generates an invalid ST_GeomFromText call with misplaced quotes and SRID.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall generate geometry literals with valid WKT in one pair of quotes and the correct SRID argument.

title: [Bug]: foreign constraint on add/edit cascade always preselected
reason: Editing a foreign key always preselects CASCADE instead of the stored ON DELETE action.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall pre-select the stored ON DELETE and ON UPDATE actions when a foreign key is edited.

title: [Bug]: renaming DB with a view fails
reason: Renaming a database with a view fails because the view SQL is rewritten as text and corrupted at a CASE expression.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall recreate views during database rename or copy from the stored view definition without rewriting its SQL text.

title: [Bug]: No load mask when copying table
reason: Copying a table shows no progress indicator, unlike other long-running operations.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show a progress indicator for any table copy or other operation that runs longer than one second.

title: Broken out of the box with PHP 7.4: Call to undefined function Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\array_is_list()
reason: Installing on Debian with PHP 7.4 and a missing Symfony helper is a PHP packaging issue.

title: WITH ROLLUP Shows "Expects delimiter" Syntax Error in LegacyAdmin, SQL Executes OK - v10.5.25-MariaDB-cll-lve
reason: A valid WITH ROLLUP statement is reported as a delimiter syntax error although it executes successfully.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not report a syntax error for a statement that the server executes successfully, including MariaDB WITH ROLLUP.

title: [Bug]: For SQL query rowcount wrong with low value of display rows
reason: The row-count rule for SQL results is already specified, and a join total equal to the FROM table count violates FR-DTB-005.

title: [Bug]: Blocked aria-hidden on an element because its descendant retained focus
reason: A modal is hidden with aria-hidden while focus stays inside it, which breaks access for screen reader users.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall move focus out of a dialog before hiding it and shall never set aria-hidden on an element that contains focus.

title: [Bug]: Continuing the upload dump after 'timeout_passed' causes errors due to a miscalculated offset
reason: Resuming an interrupted import computes the offset in characters rather than bytes, so multibyte dumps restart mid-statement and fail.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall record import resume positions in bytes and resume only at a complete statement boundary.

title: [Bug]: Remote Login uses own hostname as destination for Remote Server
reason: Logging in to a configured remote server sends the web server own host name instead of the configured one.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall connect only to the host and port configured for the selected server and never substitute another host name.

title: [Bug]: legacyadmin hangs when counting rows for locked table in schema structure view
reason: The schema structure page blocks on an exact row count of a locked table and does not load until the lock ends.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply a server-side time limit to row-count queries and fall back to an approximate count when the limit is reached.

title: [Bug]: Autocomplete is not getting any response and return code 200 with network timeout.
reason: On schemas with thousands of tables the SQL autocomplete request repeats and fails, showing network errors.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall load SQL autocomplete names once per schema with a bounded size, and shall not repeat failing requests.

title: [Feat]: Dropdown with search function on selected fields
reason: Choosing the position of a new column on a wide table means scrolling a long list, so a searchable picker is requested.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a searchable column picker for the after-column position when adding a column.

title: [Feat]: search with wildcards
reason: The table search form has no configurable default comparison, and users want a LIKE %value% default.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall let the user choose the default comparison operator, including a LIKE %value% default, in the table search form.

title: [Bug]: When browsing a table, the row count ("Showing rows 0-16") should start counting at 1, not 0
reason: The browse footer shows row ranges starting at 0 (for example 0-16), unlike the 1-based numbering of LIMIT.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall display browse row ranges 1-based, for example 1-25.

title: LegacyAdmin 5.2.3 - Queries without LIMIT return no results with 'Failed to parse JSON' error on PHP 8.4.13
reason: PHP notices that corrupt JSON responses are specific to the PHP runtime and do not apply to DBLoom JSON API.

title: [Bug]: 'Add CREATE PROCEDURE ...' option not loaded in database export template when export data disabled
reason: Loading an export template drops the routine and event option when table data is not exported.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall save and restore every export template option, including routine and event definitions, whatever the data selection.

title: Integrate AI Assistant for Query Generation, Optimization, and Schema Analysis
reason: An AI assistant for query generation and schema analysis is already recorded as a dropped feature in the new-features section.

title: [Bug]: Reverse https reverse proxy setup using LegacyAdmin 5.2.3 does throw irritating message after login
reason: Behind a reverse proxy an AJAX request with HTTP 200 still shows a connection error after login.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not show a connection error for a response with a successful HTTP status, whatever the proxy scheme.

title: [Bug]: Edit inline shows scrollbar and hides query
reason: The inline-edit SQL textarea scrolls after three lines so that its first lines disappear, although the query fits.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall size the inline SQL editor to show at least four lines without internal scrolling.

title: [Feat]: Display Database structure: List of all tables: please, show the value of data_free, too
reason: The database structure list shows data size but not free space (data_free), which users need to judge fragmentation.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show each table free data size in the database structure view when the server reports it.

title: [Bug]: EXPORT crashes program
reason: An export crash on Windows 11 with LegacyAdmin 5.2.2 is reported without a reproduction or error text.

title: [6.0] On import of a CSV, the table is created but no data is imported
reason: A CSV import that fails part way leaves an empty table created before the rows are inserted.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall create a table from an import and insert its rows in one transaction, dropping the new table if any row fails.

title: [Bug]: All Records not downloading in CSV
reason: Truncated exports are already covered: the job limits and result caps must be announced rather than silent.

title: CSV import should recognize TRUE and FALSE as boolean ?
reason: CSV-to-table import detects only NULL, integer, decimal and date types, so TRUE/FALSE columns become text.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall detect a column whose non-empty values are only TRUE and FALSE as BOOLEAN when creating a table from CSV.

title: [Bug]: Browse tab in DB schema page may link to invalid table
reason: The Browse action after a query on another schema uses the current schema, so it opens the wrong or a missing table.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall resolve the database of a table from the originating query before offering a Browse action.

title: [Feat]: Import/Export Excel (Office Open XML) Files
reason: XLSX import and export are requested; the SPEC only notes that Excel means CSV in 5.2.3 and lists it as an open gap.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall import and export XLSX (Office Open XML) workbooks for table data.

title: [Feat]: Add an option to not modify the executed SQL in any way
reason: The SQL runner silently prepends a FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS statement to user SQL, which breaks servers that reject it.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall execute user-entered SQL exactly as typed and shall not prepend session statements unless the user opts in.

title: [6.0]: SQL export options are shown on other export formats
reason: The custom export form shows SQL-specific options alongside the options of the selected CSV format.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show only the export options that belong to the selected export format.

title: [Feat]: Byte Order Mark (BOM) and delimiter for CSV exports
reason: CSV export has no option to write a UTF-8 byte-order mark for Excel, although the delimiter is already selectable.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a CSV export option to write a UTF-8 byte-order mark, off by default.

title: [Feat]: Export data only when export all table
reason: The whole-database export offers no structure-only or data-only choice for every format.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer a structure, data, or structure-and-data choice on the whole-database export screen for every format that supports it.

title: [Bug]: ErrorException: Undefined array key "Create_time"
reason: The table page fails with undefined-key errors when information_schema is disabled and status columns are missing.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show missing optional table metadata as unknown values instead of failing the table page.

title: [6.0]: Uncaught TypeError: can't convert null to object
reason: A JavaScript TypeError when editing a search result cannot be reproduced and the report has no steps.

title: [Bug]: ShowDatabasesNavigationAsTree not working as expected
reason: With the flat database navigation, selecting a database keeps all databases listed, which the reporter expected not to happen.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show only the selected database tables in the navigation panel when the flat (non-tree) database list is used.

title: [6.0] File import goes to login
reason: An upload from the import page can end on the login page because a request loses the server identifier.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the selected server context on every import request so that an upload never falls back to the login page.

title: [Bug]: Functions & Procedures names are duplicated in the navigation tree
reason: Duplicate routine names in the navigation tree may come from corrupted server state after a failed drop, and the report gives no reproducible cause.

title: SQL errors when user does not have admin privileges
reason: Privilege probing runs a query that the server denies and logs as an error on every login and logout.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall determine the connected account privileges without issuing statements that the server denies and logs as errors.

title: [Feat]: Maintainer-Issued Alerting
reason: An information banner for administrator notices after login is already planned as a settings item.

title: [Bug]: ValueError: mysqli::query(): Argument #1 ($query) must not be empty
reason: URL query encryption and decryption failures are already specified, including the encrypted-URL login case.

title: [Bug]: Adding system versioning to a table makes foreign keys unusable
reason: Foreign keys of system-versioned tables are missing from the structure view.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall list the foreign keys of system-versioned tables in the structure view.

title: [Bug]: Stuck on Loading... on error
reason: Failed requests can leave the page stuck on its loading state instead of showing an error.
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall clear every loading indicator and show an error message when a request fails or returns an error.

title: [Bug]: The LegacyAdmin configuration storage is not completely configured, some extended features have been deactivated. Find out why.
reason: A configuration-storage incomplete warning is shown for a feature the administrator has disabled
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall warn about incomplete configuration storage only for features the administrator has enabled.

title: [Bug]: ErrorException: iconv(): Wrong encoding, conversion from "utf-8" to "SJIS-win//TRANSLIT" is not allowed
reason: Exporting with the SJIS-win character set fails with an iconv error when the platform iconv does not support it
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall list only export character sets it can convert on the running platform and shall report an unsupported conversion before writing the file.

title: [Bug]: Designer side menu is not responsive
reason: The Designer side menu cannot be reached when the viewport is resized
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the designer side menu reachable at every supported viewport width.

title: [Bug]: ErrorException: Error reading structure for table test.test: #1932 - Table "test.test" doesn't exist in engine
reason: A database export with one unreadable table aborts or emits an HTML page into XML output, leaving tags unclosed
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall skip and report tables whose structure cannot be read during a database export, and still produce a well-formed file in every format.

title: [Bug]: Warning: unlink(''): No such file or directory
reason: A PHP unlink() warning on an empty file name in the legacy File class

title: Support for MySQL PDO Driver
reason: Adding an optional PDO MySQL driver is a PHP-specific choice

title: [Feat]: Default text searches to %like% instead of just like
reason: Text search defaults to exact-style LIKE without wildcards; a contains match is requested as the default
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall default text search criteria to a contains match, with the operator visible and changeable.

title: Undefined array key 0 in Relation.php getForeigners() when parsing Shopware 6 product table
reason: Undefined array key 0 in the foreign-key lookup when the SQL parser fails on a complex SHOW CREATE TABLE output
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall read foreign-key metadata without depending on a full SQL parse of SHOW CREATE TABLE output, and shall not emit warnings for tables it cannot parse.

title: [Bug]: Bookmark 'regression'
reason: Bookmarks with an empty database name were shared across all databases; the scope rule is an open question

title: [Bug]: Latest PHP (8.5.3) & Latest phpMyAdmi (5.2.3)  using old config.inc.php
reason: Old config.inc.php values using on/off strings and quoted integers cause TypeErrors under strict types

title: [Bug]: TypeError with no actionable info prevents loading throbber removal
reason: A non-JSON error page for an AJAX request leaves the loading throbber on screen with no error message
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall clear the loading indicator and show an error message whenever a background request fails or returns a non-JSON response.

title: [Bug]: Tree collapses when clicking
reason: Clicking a column in the navigation tree collapses the nodes below the table
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep expanded navigation nodes expanded when the user selects an item inside them.

title: [Bug]: Active last-level tab not remembered on refresh
reason: The active sub-tab of the preferences page is not kept on refresh
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the active preferences sub-tab in the URL so that a page refresh reopens it.

title: [Feat]: Community Helm chart available for LegacyAdmin on Kubernetes
reason: Suggestion to list a community Helm chart as a deployment option

title: [Bug]: Filtered list of tables reduces on selecting tab
reason: Switching the main-view tab reduces a filtered navigation table list to the first ten tables
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the filtered navigation tree list unchanged when the user switches main-view tabs.

title: [Bug]: mysql8 copy table with DESC index
reason: Copying a table fails when an index has a DESC column part
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the descending order of index parts when copying a table, in both structure and data copy.

title: [Bug]: ErrorException: Using null as an array offset is deprecated, use an empty string instead
reason: A PHP deprecation in the vendored sql-parser library

title: [Bug]: ErrorException: Using null as an array offset is deprecated, use an empty string instead
reason: A PHP deprecation in the vendored sql-parser library

title: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'childNodes')
reason: A JavaScript TypeError on reading childNodes is reported without the page or action that triggers it

title: [Feat]: Add Export option with version history
reason: Export has no option to include the row history of system-versioned tables (FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL)
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer an export option that includes the full row history of system-versioned tables.

title: [Bug]: Modal showing when editing a datetime value
reason: Pressing Enter twice on a datetime cell opens a modal for running queries instead of keeping inline editing usable
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep inline cell editing usable after repeated Enter presses on a datetime value and shall not open an unrelated modal.

title: [Bug]: `The $cfg['TempDir'] (/usr/share/legacyadmin/tmp/) is not accessible. `
reason: The TempDir notice is shown even when the directory is writable, a known legacy defect

title: [Bug]: zlib compressed columns return inproper prefilled edit form, structure export incomplete
reason: A COMPRESSED=zlib column is prefilled without its attribute in the edit form and is missing from structure exports
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall keep the COMPRESSED attribute of a column in the edit form and in structure exports.

title: [Bug]: Bookmark variables with non-sequential [VARIABLEn] numbers are silently dropped
reason: Bookmark variables with non-sequential [VARIABLEn] numbers are dropped because the count of placeholders is used as the highest index
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render an input for every variable index up to the highest index used in a bookmark, so gaps in [VARIABLEn] numbering never drop variables.

title: [Bug]: No error message when inserting into la_history fails
reason: A failed insert into the history table (utf8mb3 column, 4-byte characters) returns an empty response with no error message
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall report a failed history write to the user and shall store history text in utf8mb4 so that four-byte characters are kept.

title: [Bug]: [6.0] Export writes to file instead of streaming output
reason: Since 6.0, export is written to a file and then sent at once, so memory use spikes at the end of large exports and breaks memory-limited deployments
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall stream export output to the client in chunks so that peak memory does not grow with the size of the export.

title: [Bug]: How to search by table group
reason: The report mixes a question about where table-group search is in the UI with a claim that the separator config can be an array, and no clear defect is stated

title: [Feat]: transformation support for search
reason: Column input transformations are not available in the Search form, unlike the Insert form
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall offer the column's input transformation in the search form, with a function selector per criterion.

title: [Bug]: The float 1782811406433.493 is not representable as an int, cast occurred
reason: A float-to-int cast deprecation for a millisecond timestamp in the server monitor is a PHP 8.5 specific issue

title: [Bug]: "CSV using LOAD DATA" import with charset selection results in "This plugin does not support compressed imports!"
reason: Choosing any character set other than utf8 for CSV LOAD DATA import is rejected with a compressed-import error
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall allow a chosen character set for CSV LOAD DATA imports, or reject it with an explanation before the import starts.

title: [Bug]: Editing a column using table default Collation then hard sets that collation for the column
reason: Editing a column that uses the table default collation writes that collation into the column definition
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall leave a column's collation unset in the generated definition when the user does not change it.

title: [Bug]: imagecreatefromstring(): Data is not in a recognized format
reason: After a column type change, rows with non-image bytes in an image column trigger an imagecreatefromstring warning
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall render a binary value as an image only when its bytes are a valid image, and otherwise show the generic binary placeholder without a warning.

title: [Bug]: Unable to render 60k record into legacyadmin 5.2.3
reason: A join returning 60k rows times out in the browser with no partial result or clear limit message
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show the rows of a long-running query as they arrive, or report the timeout together with the limit that was reached, instead of a generic failure.

title: [Bug]: Geometry column not truncated when table is joined
reason: Geometry values are not truncated to the partial-text limit in joined result grids, unlike single-table results
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall truncate geometry values in joined result grids to the same partial-text limit used for single-table results.

title: [Bug]: Pagination count is not accurate
reason: The pagination total of a filtered table result is off by one on large MyISAM tables, so the last page is wrong
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall show a total row count that matches the filtered query, or label it clearly as an estimate, so that the last page is never empty or missing.

title: [6.0]: SkipLockedTables shows No tables found in database.
reason: With the SkipLockedTables option enabled, every database shows "No tables found" instead of listing tables, including locked ones
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall list all tables of a database when a skip-locked option is enabled and shall mark locked tables instead of hiding the whole list.

title: [Security]: I Reported a Stored XSS
reason: A stored XSS is reported without page, parameter or payload, and the reporter asks to be contacted through a personal email, so it cannot be triaged from the issue text and must go through the private security channel

title: [Bug]: Unconditional Session::secure() before login form invalidates session on every GET, causing MismatchedSessionId in browsers
reason: Session::secure() regenerates the session ID on every unauthenticated login-form GET, so a concurrent request can break the form POST with MismatchedSessionId
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall not replace an existing session cookie when it renders the unauthenticated login page; the session shall be regenerated only when credentials are submitted.

title: Dead-code audit with a code-graph tool (plouf.rs) - Things to improve so tools can better understand the codebase
reason: Outreach about an external dead-code tool and tooling suggestions, not a behaviour of LegacyAdmin

title: [6.0]: Issues after DUCKDB engine is removed
reason: After a storage engine is removed from the server, the structure page fails to render for tables that use it
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall still list and render tables whose storage engine is not installed on the server, marking the engine as unavailable instead of failing the page.

title: [Bug]: Cannot sort column DESC by click when it is named COUNT(*)
reason: Clicking a result column named COUNT(*) does not toggle to descending sort because the column name is used unsafely
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall toggle ascending and descending sort on result columns whose names contain parentheses, asterisks or other special characters.

title: Warning: Error delete _state: [403] Resource not accessible by integration
reason: A CI cache-delete warning in LegacyAdmin's own GitHub Actions workflow

title: Grant option is silently dropped when editing privileges on MySQL 8.0.11+
reason: Ticking GRANT on MySQL 8.0.11+ is silently dropped when privileges are edited, so the grant option is never given and no error is shown
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply the GRANT OPTION on MySQL 8.0.11+ and MariaDB as the user requested, and shall report an error instead of silently dropping it.

title: [Bug]: Undefined global variable $maxsize
reason: Undefined $maxsize in the export code is a known legacy defect already resolved in the SPEC

title: Does LegacyAdmin still support no-JavaScript mode?
reason: No-JavaScript fallback is a legacy PHP-era concern; DBLoom is a client-rendered TypeScript app

title: [Feat]: SVG icons for the pmahomme theme
reason: Replacing the pmahomme theme PNG icons with SVG is a theme chore specific to the legacy theme

title: Why does LegacyAdmin allow "WebAuthn/FIDO2" if  GMP or bcmath are not installed by default?
reason: WebAuthn can be enabled without the GMP or bcmath libraries and the missing dependency is not checked

title: [Bug]: Export nullable binary value
reason: A NULL in a binary column is exported in SQL as 0x, which fails on import
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall export a NULL value of any binary column as the SQL keyword NULL in SQL exports and never as 0x.

title: [6.0]: TypeError: array_map(): Argument #2 ($array) must be of type array, string given
reason: A 6.0-dev TypeError in the structure page for the mysql schema is given only as a stack line, so the failing code path cannot be identified

title: [Feat]: Update table name filter to filter all pages of table names, not just page 1.
reason: Navigation table-name filter only searches the current page of table names, so tables on other pages look missing
proposed_requirement: DBLoom shall apply the navigation tree table-name filter to all tables of the selected database, not only the visible page.
